segments.src: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Check Your Plan's Rules
segments.tr: ## 1. लचीले खर्च खाते (FSAs): अपनी योजना के नियमों की जाँच करें

segments.src: A health care FSA lets you set aside pre-tax money for eligible medical expenses.
segments.tr: स्वास्थ्य देखभाल FSA आपको पात्र चिकित्सा खर्चों के लिए कर-पूर्व धन अलग रखने देता है।

segments.src: The classic drawback is the "use it or lose it" rule: money left unspent at the end of the plan year may be forfeited.
segments.tr: क्लासिक कमी "उपयोग करें या खो दें" नियम है: योजना वर्ष के अंत में खर्च किए बिना छोड़ा गया पैसा जब्त किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: Employers can soften that rule in one of two ways, but they are not required to offer either:
segments.tr: नियोक्ता दो में से एक तरीके से उस नियम को नरम कर सकते हैं, लेकिन उन्हें किसी एक की पेशकश करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है:

segments.src: - **Carryover:** Some plans let you roll over a limited amount into the next year. The IRS adjusts the maximum carryover annually, so check the current figure with your plan.
segments.tr: - **कैरीओवर:** कुछ योजनाएं आपको अगले वर्ष में एक सीमित राशि को रोल ओवर करने देती हैं। IRS वार्षिक रूप से अधिकतम कैरीओवर को समायोजित करता है, इसलिए अपनी योजना के साथ वर्तमान आंकड़े की जाँच करें।

segments.src: - **Grace period:** Some plans give you extra time, up to two and a half months, to incur new expenses against last year's balance.
segments.tr: - **ग्रेस पीरियड:** कुछ योजनाएं आपको पिछले वर्ष की शेष राशि के मुकाबले नए खर्च करने के लिए अतिरिक्त समय, ढाई महीने तक देती हैं।

segments.src: A plan may offer one of these options, but not both.
segments.tr: एक योजना इनमें से एक विकल्प की पेशकश कर सकती है, लेकिन दोनों की नहीं।

segments.src: Many employers offer neither.
segments.tr: कई नियोक्ता किसी की भी पेशकश नहीं करते हैं।

segments.src: **What to do now:**
segments.tr: **अब क्या करना है:**

segments.src: - Log in to your FSA portal and check your remaining balance and your plan's deadline.
segments.tr: - अपने FSA पोर्टल में लॉग इन करें और अपनी शेष राशि और अपनी योजना की समय-सीमा की जाँच करें।

segments.src: - Find out whether your plan uses a carryover, a grace period, or nothing.
segments.tr: - पता लगाएं कि क्या आपकी योजना कैरीओवर, ग्रेस पीरियड या कुछ भी उपयोग नहीं करती है।

segments.src: - Look at the claims run-out deadline. Even if you incur an expense on time, you usually must submit the claim by a set date.
segments.tr: - दावों की रन-आउट समय-सीमा को देखें। भले ही आप समय पर खर्च करते हैं, आपको आमतौर पर एक निर्धारित तिथि तक दावा प्रस्तुत करना होगा।

segments.src: - Spend wisely. Eligible items often include prescription copays, dental work, vision exams and glasses, and many over-the-counter products. Check your plan's eligibility list before buying.
segments.tr: - बुद्धिमानी से खर्च करें। योग्य वस्तुओं में अक्सर नुस्खे के सह-भुगतान, दंत चिकित्सा कार्य, दृष्टि परीक्षा और चश्मा, और कई काउंटर उत्पाद शामिल होते हैं। खरीदने से पहले अपनी योजना की पात्रता सूची की जाँच करें।

segments.src: Dependent care FSAs follow their own rules and often do not allow carryover, so check them separately.
segments.tr: आश्रित देखभाल FSA अपने स्वयं के नियमों का पालन करते हैं और अक्सर कैरीओवर की अनुमति नहीं देते हैं, इसलिए उन्हें अलग से जाँचें।

segments.src: ## 2. Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
segments.tr: ## 2. आवश्यक न्यूनतम वितरण (RMDs)

segments.src: If you hold a traditional IRA or most employer retirement plans, the government eventually requires you to start withdrawing money.
segments.tr: यदि आपके पास पारंपरिक IRA या अधिकांश नियोक्ता सेवानिवृत्ति योजनाएं हैं, तो सरकार अंततः आपको पैसे निकालना शुरू करने की आवश्यकता करती है।

segments.src: These withdrawals are called required minimum distributions.
segments.tr: इन निकासी को आवश्यक न्यूनतम वितरण कहा जाता है।

segments.src: Under current federal law, the starting age depends on your birth year.
segments.tr: वर्तमान संघीय कानून के तहत, शुरुआती आयु आपके जन्म के वर्ष पर निर्भर करती है।

segments.src: It is 73 for many people today and rises to 75 for those born in 1960 or later.
segments.tr: यह आज कई लोगों के लिए 73 है और 1960 या उसके बाद पैदा हुए लोगों के लिए 75 तक बढ़ जाती है।

segments.src: Confirm your own age requirement with the IRS or a tax professional.
segments.tr: IRS या कर पेशेवर के साथ अपनी खुद की उम्र की आवश्यकता की पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: Key points:
segments.tr: मुख्य बिंदु:

segments.src: - **The annual deadline is generally December 31.** Your first RMD is the exception: you may delay it until April 1 of the following year. Delaying means you take two distributions in one calendar year, which can push you into a higher tax bracket.
segments.tr: - **वार्षिक समय सीमा आम तौर पर 31 दिसंबर है।** आपका पहला RMD अपवाद है: आप इसे अगले वर्ष के 1 अप्रैल तक देरी कर सकते हैं। देरी का मतलब है कि आप एक कैलेंडर वर्ष में दो वितरण लेते हैं, जो आपको एक उच्च कर ब्रैकेट में धकेल सकता है।

segments.src: - **Missing an RMD carries a penalty.** The excise tax on a missed amount has been reduced in recent years, but it is still significant. The IRS may waive it if you show reasonable cause and correct the shortfall promptly.
segments.tr: - **एक RMD याद करना एक दंड वहन करता है।** एक छूटी हुई राशि पर उत्पाद कर हाल के वर्षों में कम कर दिया गया है, लेकिन यह अभी भी महत्वपूर्ण है। यदि आप उचित कारण दिखाते हैं और कमी को तुरंत ठीक करते हैं तो IRS इसे माफ कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Calculations are done per account type.** Traditional IRAs can often be aggregated, so you may take the total from one account. Employer plans such as 401(k)s generally must be calculated and withdrawn separately.
segments.tr: - **गणना प्रति खाता प्रकार की जाती है।** पारंपरिक IRA को अक्सर एकत्र किया जा सकता है, इसलिए आप एक खाते से कुल ले सकते हैं। 401(k)s जैसी नियोक्ता योजनाओं की आम तौर पर गणना की जानी चाहिए और अलग से वापस ली जानी चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Inherited accounts have their own rules.** Many beneficiaries must empty inherited retirement accounts within a set number of years, and some must also take annual distributions. This area is complicated and frequently misunderstood.
segments.tr: - **विरासत में मिले खातों के अपने नियम हैं।** कई लाभार्थियों को वर्षों की एक निर्धारित संख्या के भीतर विरासत में मिले सेवानिवृत्ति खातों को खाली करना होगा, और कुछ को वार्षिक वितरण भी लेना चाहिए। यह क्षेत्र जटिल है और अक्सर गलत समझा जाता है।

segments.src: Roth IRAs do not require withdrawals during the original owner's lifetime.
segments.tr: Roth IRAs मूल मालिक के जीवनकाल के दौरान निकासी की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है।

segments.src: **Commonly missed:** People who have several accounts, who recently changed custodians, or who inherited an account sometimes overlook one of them.
segments.tr: **आमतौर पर छूट गए:** जिन लोगों के पास कई खाते हैं, जिन्होंने हाल ही में संरक्षक बदले हैं, या जिन्होंने कोई खाता विरासत में मिला है, वे कभी-कभी उनमें से एक को अनदेखा कर देते हैं।

segments.src: Ask each custodian whether an RMD is due and what amount they calculated.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक संरक्षक से पूछें कि क्या RMD देय है और उन्होंने किस राशि की गणना की है।

segments.src: ## 3. Charitable Giving
segments.tr: ## 3. धर्मार्थ दान

segments.src: Donations made by December 31 may count toward your 2026 tax year, but the benefit depends on whether you itemize deductions.
segments.tr: 31 दिसंबर तक किए गए दान आपके 2026 कर वर्ष की ओर गिन सकते हैं, लेकिन लाभ इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि क्या आप कटौती को मदवार करते हैं।

segments.src: Points to consider:
segments.tr: विचार करने योग्य बिंदु:

segments.src: - **Itemizing vs. the standard deduction.** Most households take the standard deduction, which means a cash gift may not reduce taxes unless your total itemized deductions exceed it. Recent law changes have affected how charitable deductions work for different filers, so review the current rules for 2026.
segments.tr: - **मदवार बनाम मानक कटौती।** अधिकांश परिवार मानक कटौती लेते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि एक नकद उपहार करों को कम नहीं कर सकता है जब तक कि आपकी कुल मदवार कटौती इससे अधिक न हो। हाल के कानून परिवर्तनों ने प्रभावित किया है कि विभिन्न फाइलरों के लिए धर्मार्थ कटौती कैसे काम करती है, इसलिए 2026 के लिए वर्तमान नियमों की समीक्षा करें।

segments.src: - **Timing counts.** Generally, a gift is dated when you hand it over, for example when a check is mailed or a card charge is processed. Do not wait until the last day, since processing delays can push a gift into the next year.
segments.tr: - **समय मायने रखता है।** आम तौर पर, एक उपहार को तब दिनांकित किया जाता है जब आप इसे सौंपते हैं, उदाहरण के लिए जब कोई चेक मेल किया जाता है या कार्ड चार्ज संसाधित किया जाता है। अंतिम दिन तक प्रतीक्षा न करें, क्योंकि प्रसंस्करण में देरी उपहार को अगले वर्ष में धकेल सकती है।

segments.src: - **Keep records.** Save receipts or written acknowledgments, especially for larger gifts. Confirm that the organization is a qualifying charity.
segments.tr: - **रिकॉर्ड रखें।** रसीदें या लिखित स्वीकृति सहेजें, विशेष रूप से बड़े उपहारों के लिए। पुष्टि करें कि संगठन एक योग्य दान है।

segments.src: - **Appreciated assets.** Donating stock or other assets you have held for more than a year can sometimes let you avoid capital gains tax on the appreciation. Transfers take time, so start early.
segments.tr: - **सराहना की गई संपत्ति।** स्टॉक या अन्य संपत्तियों का दान करना जो आपने एक वर्ष से अधिक समय तक रखा है, कभी-कभी आपको प्रशंसा पर पूंजीगत लाभ कर से बचने दे सकता है। स्थानांतरण में समय लगता है, इसलिए जल्दी शुरू करें।

segments.src: - **Qualified charitable distributions (QCDs).** If you are old enough (generally 70½ or older), you can send money directly from an IRA to a charity. A QCD can count toward your RMD while keeping the amount out of your taxable income. The money must go directly from the IRA to the charity.
segments.tr: - **योग्य धर्मार्थ वितरण (QCDs)।** यदि आप काफी बड़े हैं (आमतौर पर 70½ या पुराने), तो आप सीधे IRA से किसी चैरिटी को पैसे भेज सकते हैं। एक QCD आपके RMD की ओर गिन सकता है जबकि राशि को आपकी कर योग्य आय से बाहर रख सकता है। पैसा सीधे IRA से चैरिटी में जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Donor-advised funds.** These let you make a gift in one year and recommend grants to charities later, which can help you bunch several years of giving into one tax year.
segments.tr: - **दाता-सलाहकार निधि।** ये आपको एक वर्ष में उपहार देने और बाद में चैरिटी को अनुदान की सिफारिश करने देती हैं, जो आपको एक कर वर्ष में कई वर्षों के देने को बंच करने में मदद कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## 4. Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
segments.tr: ## 4. स्वास्थ्य बचत खाते (HSAs)

segments.src: HSAs differ from FSAs in one important way: the money generally stays yours and does not expire at year end.
segments.tr: HSA एक महत्वपूर्ण तरीके से FSA से अलग हैं: पैसा आम तौर पर आपका रहता है और वर्ष के अंत में समाप्त नहीं होता है।

segments.src: However, some HSA-related deadlines still matter.
segments.tr: हालांकि, कुछ HSA- संबंधित समय-सीमाएँ अभी भी महत्वपूर्ण हैं।

segments.src: - **Eligibility.** You can contribute only if you are covered by a qualifying high-deductible health plan and have no disqualifying other coverage.
segments.tr: - **पात्रता।** आप तभी योगदान कर सकते हैं जब आप एक योग्य उच्च-कटौती योग्य स्वास्थ्य योजना द्वारा कवर किए जाते हैं और आपके पास कोई अयोग्य अन्य कवरेज नहीं है।

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits for self-only and family coverage, with an additional catch-up amount for those 55 and older. Check the 2026 figures before you contribute.

- **Deadline.** Unlike many year-end items, you can usually make contributions for the tax year until the tax filing deadline the following April. Payroll contributions, however, must go through your employer during the year.
segments.tr: - **समय सीमा।** कई वर्ष के अंत की वस्तुओं के विपरीत, आप आमतौर पर अगले अप्रैल में कर दाखिल करने की समय सीमा तक कर वर्ष के लिए योगदान कर सकते हैं। हालांकि, पेरोल योगदान को वर्ष के दौरान आपके नियोक्ता के माध्यम से जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Don't overfund.** Contributing above the limit, including employer contributions, can trigger a tax penalty unless corrected.
segments.tr: - **ओवरफंड न करें।** सीमा से अधिक योगदान करना, नियोक्ता योगदान सहित, एक कर दंड को ट्रिगर कर सकता है जब तक कि सही न किया जाए।

segments.src: - **Last-month rule.** In certain cases, being eligible in December can allow a full-year contribution, but it comes with a testing period. Understand the conditions before relying on it.
segments.tr: - **अंतिम-महीने का नियम।** कुछ मामलों में, दिसंबर में पात्र होने से पूर्ण वर्ष के योगदान की अनुमति मिल सकती है, लेकिन यह एक परीक्षण अवधि के साथ आता है। उस पर भरोसा करने से पहले शर्तों को समझें।

segments.src: ## 5. Other Deadlines Worth a Quick Look
segments.tr: ## 5. अन्य समय-सीमाएँ जो एक त्वरित नज़र के लायक हैं

segments.src: - **Open enrollment.** Many employer benefit elections, including FSA and HSA amounts, are set during open enrollment. Mark the deadline for choosing 2027 benefits.
segments.tr: - **खुला नामांकन।** FSA और HSA राशियों सहित कई नियोक्ता लाभ चुनावों को खुले नामांकन के दौरान सेट किया जाता है। 2027 लाभ चुनने के लिए समय सीमा को चिह्नित करें।

segments.src: - **Retirement plan contributions.** Contributions to a 401(k) generally have to be made through payroll by December 31, while IRA contributions can usually be made until the filing deadline in April. Check whether you are on track to reach your contribution goal and whether your employer match is fully captured.
segments.tr: - **सेवानिवृत्ति योजना योगदान।** 401(k) में योगदान आम तौर पर 31 दिसंबर तक पेरोल के माध्यम से किया जाना चाहिए, जबकि IRA योगदान आम तौर पर अप्रैल में दाखिल करने की समय सीमा तक किया जा सकता है। जाँच करें कि क्या आप अपने योगदान के लक्ष्य तक पहुँचने की राह पर हैं और क्या आपका नियोक्ता मैच पूरी तरह से कब्जा कर लिया गया है।

segments.src: - **Tax-loss harvesting.** Investors with taxable accounts sometimes sell losing positions to offset gains. Be aware of the wash-sale rule, which can disallow a loss if you buy back a substantially identical investment too soon.
segments.tr: - **कर-नुकसान संचयन।** कर योग्य खातों वाले निवेशक कभी-कभी लाभ की भरपाई के लिए हारने वाली स्थिति बेचते हैं। वॉश-सेल नियम से अवगत रहें, जो बहुत जल्दी लगभग समान निवेश को वापस खरीदने पर नुकसान को अस्वीकार कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Gift tax annual exclusion.** Gifts to individuals up to the annual limit generally do not require a gift tax return. The exclusion does not carry over to the next year.
segments.tr: - **उपहार कर वार्षिक बहिष्करण।** वार्षिक सीमा तक व्यक्तियों को उपहार आम तौर पर उपहार कर रिटर्न की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है। बहिष्करण अगले वर्ष में नहीं जाता है।

segments.src: - **Estimated taxes.** If you have freelance, business or investment income, review whether you have paid enough during the year to avoid underpayment penalties.
segments.tr: - **अनुमानित कर।** यदि आपके पास फ्रीलान্সে, व्यवसाय या निवेश आय है, तो समीक्षा करें कि क्या आपने कम भुगतान दंड से बचने के लिए वर्ष के दौरान पर्याप्त भुगतान किया है।

segments.src: - **Insurance and plan reviews.** Check beneficiary designations, since outdated ones can override what you intend.
segments.tr: - **बीमा और योजना समीक्षा।** लाभार्थी पदनामों की जाँच करें, क्योंकि पुराने वाले आपके इरादे को ओवरराइड कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## A Simple Year-End Checklist
segments.tr: ## एक साधारण वर्ष के अंत की चेकलिस्ट

segments.src: 1. **This week:** Check FSA balances and your plan's carryover or grace-period policy.
segments.tr: 1. **इस सप्ताह:** FSA शेष और अपनी योजना के कैरीओवर या ग्रेस-पीरियड नीति की जाँच करें।

segments.src: 2. **By mid-November:** Confirm whether you owe an RMD and contact each custodian.
segments.tr: 2. **नवंबर के मध्य तक:** पुष्टि करें कि क्या आप RMD के ऋणी हैं और प्रत्येक संरक्षक से संपर्क करें।

segments.src: 3. **By early December:** Decide on charitable gifts and start any stock transfers.
segments.tr: 3. **दिसंबर की शुरुआत तक:** धर्मार्थ उपहारों पर निर्णय लें और कोई भी स्टॉक ट्रांसफर शुरू करें।

segments.src: 4. **Before December 31:** Make final payroll contribution changes where possible, and complete RMDs and any FSA spending.
segments.tr: 4. **31 दिसंबर से पहले:** जहाँ संभव हो अंतिम पेरोल योगदान परिवर्तन करें, और RMDs और किसी भी FSA खर्च को पूरा करें।

segments.src: 5. **In January:** Gather tax documents and plan your HSA and IRA contributions for the prior year.
segments.tr: 5. **जनवरी में:** कर दस्तावेज़ एकत्र करें और पिछले वर्ष के लिए अपने HSA और IRA योगदान की योजना बनाएं।

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: Not every deadline applies to everyone.
segments.tr: हर समय सीमा सभी पर लागू नहीं होती है।

segments.src: The costliest mistakes tend to be the quiet ones: a forgotten FSA balance, a missed RMD on a lesser-used account, or a donation that is processed too late.
segments.tr: सबसे महंगे नक्शे शांत वाले होते हैं: एक भूला हुआ FSA शेष, कम उपयोग किए जाने वाले खाते पर एक छूटा हुआ RMD, या एक दान जो बहुत देर से संसाधित होता है।

segments.src: A short review in the next few weeks can help you avoid unpleasant surprises.
segments.tr: अगले कुछ हफ्तों में एक छोटी समीक्षा आपको अप्रिय आश्चर्य से बचने में मदद कर सकती है।

segments.src: When in doubt, check with your plan administrator or a tax professional, since limits and rules change from year to year.
segments.tr: संदेह होने पर, अपने योजना प्रशासक या कर पेशेवर से जाँच करें, क्योंकि सीमाएं और नियम साल-दर-साल बदलते हैं।

ar.title: استخدمها أو تفقدها: المواعيد النهائية المالية ل نهاية العام التي تستحق التحقق منها قبل 31 ديسمبر

segments.src: With roughly two months left in 2026, now is a practical time to review a handful of money deadlines that fall on or near December 31.
segments.tr: مع بقاء شهرين تقريبًا في عام 2026، حان الوقت العملي لمراجعة حزمة من المواعيد النهائية المالية التي تصادف في 31 ديسمبر أو قريبًا منه.

segments.src: Some can cost you real money if missed, while others are optional but useful.
segments.tr: قد يكلفك تفويت بعضها أموالاً حقيقية، بينما يُعد بعضها الآخر اختياريًا ولكنه مفيد.

segments.src: This guide covers which ones matter, who they apply to, and which are most often overlooked.
segments.tr: يغطي هذا الدليل المواعيد المهمة، ومن تنطبق عليهم، وتلك التي يتم إغفالها في أغلب الأحيان.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax, legal or financial advice.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة هي معلومات عامة وليست نصيحة ضريبية أو قانونية أو مالية.

segments.src: Rules vary by plan and personal situation, so confirm details with your plan administrator, the IRS, or a qualified professional.*
segments.tr: تختلف القواعد حسب الخطة والوضع الشخصي، لذا يُرجى تأكيد التفاصيل مع مسؤول الخطة لديك، أو IRS، أو متخصص مؤهل.*

segments.src: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Check Your Plan's Rules
segments.tr: ## 1. حسابات الإنفاق المرن (FSAs): تحقق من قواعد خطتك

segments.src: A health care FSA lets you set aside pre-tax money for eligible medical expenses.
segments.tr: يتيح لك حساب FSA للرعاية الصحية اقتطاع أموال قبل الخصم الضريبي للمصروفات الطبية المؤهلة.

segments.src: The classic drawback is the "use it or lose it" rule: money left unspent at the end of the plan year may be forfeited.
segments.tr: العيب التقليدي هو قاعدة "استخدمها أو تفقدها": فالمبالغ التي تظل دون إنفاق في نهاية سنة الخطة قد يتم مصادرتها.

segments.src: Employers can soften that rule in one of two ways, but they are not required to offer either:
segments.tr: يمكن لأرباب العمل تخفيف هذه القاعدة بإحدى طريقتين، لكنهم غير ملزمين بتقديم أي منهما:

segments.src: - **Carryover:** Some plans let you roll over a limited amount into the next year. The IRS adjusts the maximum carryover annually, so check the current figure with your plan.
segments.tr: - **الترحيل:** تتيح لك بعض الخطط ترحيل مبلغ محدود إلى العام التالي. تقوم IRS بتعديل الحد الأقصى للترحيل سنويًا، لذا تحقق من الرقم الحالي مع خطتك.

segments.src: - **Grace period:** Some plans give you extra time, up to two and a half months, to incur new expenses against last year's balance.
segments.tr: - **فترة السماح:** تمنحك بعض الخطط وقتًا إضافيًا، يصل إلى شهرين ونصف، لتكبد مصاريف جديدة خصمًا من رصيد العام الماضي.

segments.src: A plan may offer one of these options, but not both.
segments.tr: قد تقدم الخطة أحد هذين الخيارين، ولكن ليس كلاهما.

segments.src: Many employers offer neither.
segments.tr: والعديد من أرباب العمل لا يقدمون أيًا منهما.

segments.src: **What to do now:**
segments.tr: **ما يجب فعله الآن:**

segments.src: - Log in to your FSA portal and check your remaining balance and your plan's deadline.
segments.tr: - قم بالتسجيل في بوابة FSA الخاصة بك وتحقق من رصيدك المتبقي والموعد النهائي لخطتك.

segments.src: - Find out whether your plan uses a carryover, a grace period, or nothing.
segments.tr: - اكتشف ما إذا كانت خطتك تستخدم الترحيل، أم فترة السماح، أم لا شيء من ذلك.

segments.src: - Look at the claims run-out deadline. Even if you incur an expense on time, you usually must submit the claim by a set date.
segments.tr: - انظر إلى الموعد النهائي لتقديم المطالبات. حتى لو تكبدت ماليًا في الوقت المناسب، يتعين عليك عادةً تقديم المطالبة بحلول تاريخ محدد.

segments.src: - Spend wisely. Eligible items often include prescription copays, dental work, vision exams and glasses, and many over-the-counter products. Check your plan's eligibility list before buying.
segments.tr: - أنفق بذكاء. تشمل العناصر المؤهلة غالبًا المدفوعات المشتركة للوصفات الطبية، وأعمال الأسنان، وفحوصات النظر والنظارات، والعديد من المنتجات التي تُباع دون وصفة طبية. تحقق من قائمة الأهلية لخطتك قبل الشراء.

segments.src: Dependent care FSAs follow their own rules and often do not allow carryover, so check them separately.
segments.tr: تتبع حسابات FSA لرعاية المعالين قواعدها الخاصة وغالبًا لا تسمح بالترحيل، لذا تحقق منها بشكل منفصل.

segments.src: ## 2. Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
segments.tr: ## 2. التوزيعات الأدنى المطلوبة (RMDs)

segments.src: If you hold a traditional IRA or most employer retirement plans, the government eventually requires you to start withdrawing money.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تمتلك حساب IRA تقليديًا أو معظم خطط التقاعد الخاصة بجهة العمل، فإن الحكومة تتطلب منك في النهاية البدء في سحب الأموال.

segments.src: These withdrawals are called required minimum distributions.
segments.tr: تسمى هذه السحوبات التوزيعات الأدنى المطلوبة.

segments.src: Under current federal law, the starting age depends on your birth year.
segments.tr: بموجب القانون الفيدرالي الحالي، يعتمد سن البدء على سنة ميلادك.

segments.src: It is 73 for many people today and rises to 75 for those born in 1960 or later.
segments.tr: وهو 73 للعديد من الأشخاص اليوم ويرتفع إلى 75 لأولئك المولودين في عام 1960 أو ما بعده.

segments.src: Confirm your own age requirement with the IRS or a tax professional.
segments.tr: تأكد من شرط السن الخاص بك مع IRS أو متخصص ضريبي.

segments.src: Key points:
segments.tr: نقاط رئيسية:

segments.src: - **The annual deadline is generally December 31.** Your first RMD is the exception: you may delay it until April 1 of the following year. Delaying means you take two distributions in one calendar year, which can push you into a higher tax bracket.
segments.tr: - **الموعد النهائي السنوي بشكل عام هو 31 ديسمبر.** أول RMD لك هو الاستثناء: يمكنك تأجيله حتى 1 أبريل من العام التالي. يعني التأجيل أنك تأخذ توزيعين في عام تقويمي واحد، مما قد يدفعك إلى شريحة ضريبية أعلى.

segments.src: - **Missing an RMD carries a penalty.** The excise tax on a missed amount has been reduced in recent years, but it is still significant. The IRS may waive it if you show reasonable cause and correct the shortfall promptly.
segments.tr: - **تفويت RMD يترتب عليه غرامة.** تم تخفيض ضريبة الإنتاج على المبلغ المفوت في السنوات الأخيرة، لكنها لا تزال كبيرة. قد تتنازل IRS عنها إذا أظهرت سببًا معقولاً وقمت بتصحيح النقص فورًا.

segments.src: - **Calculations are done per account type.** Traditional IRAs can often be aggregated, so you may take the total from one account. Employer plans such as 401(k)s generally must be calculated and withdrawn separately.
segments.tr: - **تتم الحسابات حسب نوع الحساب.** يمكن غالبًا تجميع حسابات IRA التقليدية، بحيث يمكنك أخذ المجموع من حساب واحد. أما خطط أصحاب العمل مثل 401(k) فيجب عمومًا احتسابها وسحبها بشكل منفصل.

segments.src: - **Inherited accounts have their own rules.** Many beneficiaries must empty inherited retirement accounts within a set number of years, and some must also take annual distributions. This area is complicated and frequently misunderstood.
segments.tr: - **الحسابات الموروثة لها قواعدها الخاصة.** يجب على العديد من المستفيدين تفريغ حسابات التقاعد الموروثة خلال عدد محدد من السنوات، ويجب على البعض أيضًا أخذ توزيعات سنوية. هذا المجال معقد وغالبًا ما يُفهم بشكل خاطئ.

segments.src: Roth IRAs do not require withdrawals during the original owner's lifetime.
segments.tr: لا تتطلب حسابات Roth IRA السحب خلال حياة المالك الأصلي.

segments.src: **Commonly missed:** People who have several accounts, who recently changed custodians, or who inherited an account sometimes overlook one of them.
segments.tr: **يُغفل عنه شائعًا:** الأشخاص الذين لديهم حسابات متعددة، أو الذين غيروا أمانة الحساب مؤخرًا، أو الذين ورثوا حسابًا يغفلون أحيانًا عن أحدها.

segments.src: Ask each custodian whether an RMD is due and what amount they calculated.
segments.tr: اسأل كل أمين حساب عما إذا كان هناك RMD مستحق وما هو المبلغ الذي قاموا باحتسابه.

segments.src: ## 3. Charitable Giving
segments.tr: ## 3. التبرعات الخيرية

segments.src: Donations made by December 31 may count toward your 2026 tax year, but the benefit depends on whether you itemize deductions.
segments.tr: التبرعات المقدمة بحلول 31 ديسمبر قد تُحتسب ضمن سنتك الضريبية 2026، ولكن الفائدة تعتمد على ما إذا كنت تفصل الاستقطاعات.

segments.src: Points to consider:
segments.tr: نقاط يجب مراعاتها:

segments.src: - **Itemizing vs. the standard deduction.** Most households take the standard deduction, which means a cash gift may not reduce taxes unless your total itemized deductions exceed it. Recent law changes have affected how charitable deductions work for different filers, so review the current rules for 2026.
segments.tr: - **تفضيل التفصيل مقابل الاستقطاع القياسي.** تأخذ معظم الأسر الاستقطاع القياسي، مما يعني أن التبرع النقدي قد لا يقلل الضرائب ما لم تتجاوز إجمالي استقطاعاتك المفصلة ذلك الاستقطاع. أثرت التغييرات القانونية الأخيرة على كيفية عمل الاستقطاعات الخيرية لمختلف مقدمي الإقرارات، لذا راجع القواعد الحالية لعام 2026.

segments.src: - **Timing counts.** Generally, a gift is dated when you hand it over, for example when a check is mailed or a card charge is processed. Do not wait until the last day, since processing delays can push a gift into the next year.
segments.tr: - **التوقيت يهم.** عمومًا، يُؤرخ التبرع عند تسليمه، على سبيل المثال عند إرسال شيك بالبريد أو معالجة خصم بطاقة. لا تنتظر حتى اليوم الاخير، حيث قد تدفع تأخيرات المعالجة بالتبرع إلى العام التالي.

segments.src: - **Keep records.** Save receipts or written acknowledgments, especially for larger gifts. Confirm that the organization is a qualifying charity.
segments.tr: - **احتفظ بالسجلات.** احفظ الإيصالات أو الإقرارات الخطية، خاصة للتبرعات الكبيرة. تأكد من أن المنظمة هي جمعية خيرية مؤهلة.

segments.src: - **Appreciated assets.** Donating stock or other assets you have held for more than a year can sometimes let you avoid capital gains tax on the appreciation. Transfers take time, so start early.
segments.tr: - **الأصول المرتفعة القيمة.** تبرعك بأسهم أو أصول أخرى تمتلكها لأكثر من عام قد يتيح لك أحيانًا تجنب ضريبة الأرباح الرأسمالية على الزيادة في القيمة. تستغرق التحويلات وقتًا، لذا ابدأ مبكرًا.

segments.src: - **Qualified charitable distributions (QCDs).** If you are old enough (generally 70½ or older), you can send money directly from an IRA to a charity. A QCD can count toward your RMD while keeping the amount out of your taxable income. The money must go directly from the IRA to the charity.
segments.tr: - **التوزيعات الخيرية المؤهلة (QCDs).** إذا كنت كبيرًا بما يكفي في السن (عمومًا 70½ أو أكبر)، يمكنك إرسال الأموال مباشرة من حساب IRA إلى جمعية خيرية. يمكن أن يُحتسب QCD ضمن RMD الخاص بك مع إبقاء المبلغ خارج دخلك الخاضع للضريبة. يجب أن تنتقل الأموال مباشرة من IRA إلى الجمعية الخيرية.

segments.src: - **Donor-advised funds.** These let you make a gift in one year and recommend grants to charities later, which can help you bunch several years of giving into one tax year.
segments.tr: - **صناديق المانحين الموجهة.** تتيح لك هذه الصناديق تقديم تبرع في عام واحد والتوصية بتقديم منح للجمعيات الخيرية لاحقًا، مما قد يساعدك على تجميع عدة سنوات من التبرعات في عام ضريبي واحد.

segments.src: ## 4. Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
segments.tr: ## 4. حسابات التوفير الصحي (HSAs)

segments.src: HSAs differ from FSAs in one important way: the money generally stays yours and does not expire at year end.
segments.tr: تختلف حسابات HSA عن FSAs في أمر هام واحد: تظل الأموال ملكك عمومًا ولا تنتهي صلاحيتها في نهاية العام.

segments.src: However, some HSA-related deadlines still matter.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فإن بعض المواعيد النهائية المتعلقة بـ HSA تظل مهمة.

segments.src: - **Eligibility.** You can contribute only if you are covered by a qualifying high-deductible health plan and have no disqualifying other coverage.
segments.tr: - **الأهلية.** يمكنك المساهمة فقط إذا كنت مشمولاً بخطة صحية مؤهلة ذات اقتطاع عالٍ وليس لديك تغطية أخرى تلغي الأهلية.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits for self-only and family coverage, with an additional catch-up amount for those 55 and older. Check the 2026 figures before you contribute.
segments.tr: - **حدود المساهمة.** تضع IRS حدودًا سنوية للتغطية الفردية والعائلية، مع مبلغ إضافي للتعويض لمن هم في سن 55 أو أكبر. تحقق من أرقام عام 2026 قبل المساهمة.

segments.src: - **Deadline.** Unlike many year-end items, you can usually make contributions for the tax year until the tax filing deadline the following April. Payroll contributions, however, must go through your employer during the year.
segments.tr: - **الموعد النهائي.** بخلاف العديد من عناصر نهاية العام، يمكنك عادةً تقديم مساهمات للسنة الضريبية حتى الموعد النهائي لتقديم الإقرار الضريبي في أبريل التالي. ومع ذلك، يجب أن تمر المساهمات المقتطعة من رواتبك عبر صاحب العمل خلال العام.

segments.src: - **Don't overfund.** Contributing above the limit, including employer contributions, can trigger a tax penalty unless corrected.
segments.tr: - **لا تفرط في التمويل.** المساهمة بأعلى من الحد المسموح به، بما في ذلك مساهمات صاحب العمل، قد تؤدي إلى غرامة ضريبية ما لم يتم تصحيحها.

segments.src: - **Last-month rule.** In certain cases, being eligible in December can allow a full-year contribution, but it comes with a testing period. Understand the conditions before relying on it.
segments.tr: - **قاعدة الشهر الأخير.** في حالات معينة، قد تتيح لك الأهلية في شهر ديسمبر تقديم مساهمة لسنة كاملة، ولكنها تأتي مع فترة اختبار. افهم الشروط قبل الاعتماد عليها.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Deadlines Worth a Quick Look
segments.tr: ## 5. مواعيد نهائية أخرى تستحق نظرة سريعة

segments.src: - **Open enrollment.** Many employer benefit elections, including FSA and HSA amounts, are set during open enrollment. Mark the deadline for choosing 2027 benefits.
segments.tr: - **التسجيل المفتوح.** يتم تحديد العديد من خيارات مزايا أصحاب العمل، بما في ذلك مبالغ FSA و HSA، خلال فترة التسجيل المفتوح. حدد الموعد النهائي لاختيار مزايا عام 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement plan contributions.** Contributions to a 401(k) generally have to be made through payroll by December 31, while IRA contributions can usually be made until the filing deadline in April. Check whether you are on track to reach your contribution goal and whether your employer match is fully captured.
segments.tr: - **مساهمات خطة التقاعد.** يجب عمومًا تقديم المساهمات في 401(k) من خلال كشوف المرتبات بحلول 31 ديسمبر، بينما يمكن عادةً تقديم مساهمات IRA حتى الموعد النهائي للإقرار في أبريل. تحقق مما إذا كنت في طريقك لتحقيق هدف مساهمتك وما إذا تم استيفاء مطابقة صاحب العمل بالكامل.

segments.src: - **Tax-loss harvesting.** Investors with taxable accounts sometimes sell losing positions to offset gains. Be aware of the wash-sale rule, which can disallow a loss if you buy back a substantially identical investment too soon.
segments.tr: - **جني الخسائر الضريبية.** يبيع المستثمرون الذين لديهم حسابات خاضعة للضريبة أحيانًا المراكز الخاسرة لموازنة المكاسب. كن على دراية بقاعدة البيع الصوري (wash-sale rule)، والتي قد ترفض الخسارة إذا قمت بإعادة شراء استثمار مماثل بشكل جوهري في وقت قريب جدًا.

segments.src: - **Gift tax annual exclusion.** Gifts to individuals up to the annual limit generally do not require a gift tax return. The exclusion does not carry over to the next year.
segments.tr: - **الاستثناء السنوي لضريبة الهدايا.** الهدايا للأفراد حتى الحد السنوي لا تتطلب عمومًا إقرارًا لضريبة الهدايا. الاستثناء لا يترحل إلى العام التالي.

segments.src: - **Estimated taxes.** If you have freelance, business or investment income, review whether you have paid enough during the year to avoid underpayment penalties.
segments.tr: - **الضرائب التقديرية.** إذا كان لديك دخل من العمل الحر أو الأعمال التجارية أو الاستثمار، فراجع ما إذا كنت قد دفعت ما يكفي خلال العام لتجنب غرامات نقص الدفع.

segments.src: - **Insurance and plan reviews.** Check beneficiary designations, since outdated ones can override what you intend.
segments.tr: - **مراجعات التأمين والخطط.** تحقق من تعيينات المستفيدين، حيث يمكن للتعيينات القديمة أن تتجاوز ما تنويه.

segments.src: ## A Simple Year-End Checklist
segments.tr: ## قائمة مرجعية بسيطة لنهاية العام

segments.src: 1. **This week:** Check FSA balances and your plan's carryover or grace-period policy.
segments.tr: 1. **هذا الأسبوع:** تحقق من أرصدة FSA وسياسة الترحيل أو فترة السماح لخطتك.

segments.src: 2. **By mid-November:** Confirm whether you owe an RMD and contact each custodian.
segments.tr: 2. **بحلول منتصف نوفمبر:** تأكد مما إذا كان عليك RMD وتواصل مع كل أمين حساب.

segments.src: 3. **By early December:** Decide on charitable gifts and start any stock transfers.
segments.tr: 3. **بحلول أواخر ديسمبر:** قرر بشأن التبرعات الخيرية وابدأ في أي تحويلات للأسهم.

segments.src: 4. **Before December 31:** Make final payroll contribution changes where possible, and complete RMDs and any FSA spending.
segments.tr: 4. **قبل 31 ديسمبر:** أجرِ التغييرات النهائية على مساهمات كشف المرتبات حيثما أمكن، وأكمل الـ RMDs وأي إنفاق من FSA.

segments.src: 5. **In January:** Gather tax documents and plan your HSA and IRA contributions for the prior year.
segments.tr: 5. **في يناير:** اجمع المستندات الضريبية وخطط لمساهمات HSA و IRA للعام السابق.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Not every deadline applies to everyone.
segments.tr: لا ينطبق كل موعد نهائي على الجميع.

segments.src: The costliest mistakes tend to be the quiet ones: a forgotten FSA balance, a missed RMD on a lesser-used account, or a donation that is processed too late.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تكون الأخطاء الأكثر تكلفة هي الصامتة: رصيد FSA منسي، أو RMD مفوت في حساب نادر الاستخدام، أو تبرع تمت معالجته متأخرًا جدًا.

segments.src: A short review in the next few weeks can help you avoid unpleasant surprises.
segments.tr: يمكن لمراجعة قصيرة في الأسابيع القليلة القادمة أن تساعدك على تجنب المفاجآت غير السارة.

segments.src: When in doubt, check with your plan administrator or a tax professional, since limits and rules change from year to year.
segments.tr: عند الشك، تحقق مع مسؤول الخطة أو متخصص ضريبي، حيث تتغير الحدود والقواعد من سنة إلى أخرى.

fr.title: Utilisez-le ou perdez-le : les échéances financières de fin d'année à vérifier avant le 31 décembre

segments.src: With roughly two months left in 2026, now is a practical time to review a handful of money deadlines that fall on or near December 31.
segments.tr: À environ deux mois de la fin de l'année 2026, c'est le moment idéal pour examiner quelques échéances financières qui tombent le 31 décembre ou aux alentours.

segments.src: Some can cost you real money if missed, while others are optional but useful.
segments.tr: Certaines peuvent vous coûter de l'argent réel si vous les manquez, tandis que d'autres sont facultatives mais utiles.

segments.src: This guide covers which ones matter, who they apply to, and which are most often overlooked.
segments.tr: Ce guide couvre celles qui sont importantes, à qui elles s'appliquent et lesquelles sont le plus souvent négligées.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax, legal or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Cet article constitue une information générale et non un conseil fiscal, juridique ou financier.

segments.src: Rules vary by plan and personal situation, so confirm details with your plan administrator, the IRS, or a qualified professional.*
segments.tr: Les règles varient selon le régime et la situation personnelle, veuillez donc confirmer les détails auprès de l'administrateur de votre régime, de l'IRS ou d'un professionnel qualifié.*

segments.src: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Check Your Plan's Rules
segments.tr: ## 1. Comptes de dépenses flexibles (FSA) : vérifiez les règles de votre régime

segments.src: A health care FSA lets you set aside pre-tax money for eligible medical expenses.
segments.tr: Un FSA de soins de santé vous permet de mettre de côté de l'argent avant impôts pour des dépenses médicales éligibles.

segments.src: The classic drawback is the "use it or lose it" rule: money left unspent at the end of the plan year may be forfeited.
segments.tr: L'inconvénient classique est la règle du « utilisez-le ou perdez-le » : l'argent non dépensé à la fin de l'année du régime peut être perdu.

segments.src: Employers can soften that rule in one of two ways, but they are not required to offer either:
segments.tr: Les employeurs peuvent assouplir cette règle de deux manières, mais ils ne sont pas tenus d'offrir l'une ou l'autre :

segments.src: - **Carryover:** Some plans let you roll over a limited amount into the next year. The IRS adjusts the maximum carryover annually, so check the current figure with your plan.
segments.tr: - **Report (Carryover) :** Certains régimes vous permettent de reporter un montant limité sur l'année suivante. L'IRS ajuste le report maximum chaque année, vérifiez donc le chiffre actuel auprès de votre régime.

segments.src: - **Grace period:** Some plans give you extra time, up to two and a half months, to incur new expenses against last year's balance.
segments.tr: - **Période de grâce :** Certains régimes vous accordent un délai supplémentaire, jusqu'à deux mois et demi, pour engager de nouvelles dépenses sur le solde de l'année précédente.

segments.src: A plan may offer one of these options, but not both.
segments.tr: Un régime peut offrir l'une de ces options, mais pas les deux.

segments.src: Many employers offer neither.
segments.tr: De nombreux employeurs n'offrent aucune des deux.

segments.src: **What to do now:**
segments.tr: **Que faire maintenant :**

segments.src: - Log in to your FSA portal and check your remaining balance and your plan's deadline.
segments.tr: - Connectez-vous à votre portail FSA et vérifiez votre solde restant ainsi que l'échéance de votre régime.

segments.src: - Find out whether your plan uses a carryover, a grace period, or nothing.
segments.tr: - Découvrez si votre régime utilise un report, une période de grâce ou rien du tout.

segments.src: - Look at the claims run-out deadline. Even if you incur an expense on time, you usually must submit the claim by a set date.
segments.tr: - Vérifiez la date limite de soumission des demandes de remboursement. Même si vous engagez une dépense à temps, vous devez généralement soumettre la demande avant une date fixée.

segments.src: - Spend wisely. Eligible items often include prescription copays, dental work, vision exams and glasses, and many over-the-counter products. Check your plan's eligibility list before buying.
segments.tr: - Dépensez judicieusement. Les articles éligibles incluent souvent les quotes-parts sur ordonnance, les soins dentaires, les examens de la vue et les lunettes, ainsi que de nombreux produits en vente libre. Vérifiez la liste d'éligibilité de votre régime avant d'acheter.

segments.src: Dependent care FSAs follow their own rules and often do not allow carryover, so check them separately.
segments.tr: Les FSA pour soins aux personnes à charge suivent leurs propres règles et ne permettent souvent pas le report, vérifiez-les donc séparément.

segments.src: ## 2. Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
segments.tr: ## 2. Distributions minimales requises (RMD)

segments.src: If you hold a traditional IRA or most employer retirement plans, the government eventually requires you to start withdrawing money.
segments.tr: Si vous détenez un IRA traditionnel ou la plupart des régimes de retraite d'employeur, le gouvernement exige tôt ou tard que vous commenciez à retirer de l'argent.

segments.src: These withdrawals are called required minimum distributions.
segments.tr: Ces retraits sont appelés distributions minimales requises.

segments.src: Under current federal law, the starting age depends on your birth year.
segments.tr: Selon la loi fédérale actuelle, l'âge de début dépend de votre année de naissance.

segments.src: It is 73 for many people today and rises to 75 for those born in 1960 or later.
segments.tr: Il est de 73 ans pour beaucoup de personnes aujourd'hui et passe à 75 ans pour ceux nés en 1960 ou après.

segments.src: Confirm your own age requirement with the IRS or a tax professional.
segments.tr: Confirmez votre propre exigence d'âge auprès de l'IRS ou d'un professionnel de la fiscalité.

segments.src: Key points:
segments.tr: Points clés :

segments.src: - **The annual deadline is generally December 31.** Your first RMD is the exception: you may delay it until April 1 of the following year. Delaying means you take two distributions in one calendar year, which can push you into a higher tax bracket.
segments.tr: - **L'échéance annuelle est généralement le 31 décembre.** Votre première RMD fait exception : vous pouvez la retarder jusqu'au 1er avril de l'année suivante. Retarder signifie que vous effectuez deux distributions au cours d'une même année civile, ce qui peut vous faire passer dans une tranche d'imposition supérieure.

segments.src: - **Missing an RMD carries a penalty.** The excise tax on a missed amount has been reduced in recent years, but it is still significant. The IRS may waive it if you show reasonable cause and correct the shortfall promptly.
segments.tr: - **Manquer une RMD entraîne une pénalité.** La taxe d'accise sur un montant manqué a été réduite ces dernières années, mais elle reste importante. L'IRS peut l'annuler si vous démontrez une cause raisonnable et corrigez le manque rapidement.

segments.src: - **Calculations are done per account type.** Traditional IRAs can often be aggregated, so you may take the total from one account. Employer plans such as 401(k)s generally must be calculated and withdrawn separately.
segments.tr: - **Les calculs sont effectués par type de compte.** Les IRA traditionnels peuvent souvent être regroupés, vous pouvez donc prendre le total à partir d'un seul compte. Les régimes d'employeur tels que les 401(k) doivent généralement être calculés et retirés séparément.

segments.src: - **Inherited accounts have their own rules.** Many beneficiaries must empty inherited retirement accounts within a set number of years, and some must also take annual distributions. This area is complicated and frequently misunderstood.
segments.tr: - **Les comptes hérités ont leurs propres règles.** De nombreux bénéficiaires doivent vider les comptes de retraite hérités dans un nombre d'années défini, et certains doivent également effectuer des distributions annuelles. Ce domaine est complexe et fréquemment mal compris.

segments.src: Roth IRAs do not require withdrawals during the original owner's lifetime.
segments.tr: Les IRA Roth ne nécessitent pas de retraits pendant la vie du propriétaire initial.

segments.src: **Commonly missed:** People who have several accounts, who recently changed custodians, or who inherited an account sometimes overlook one of them.
segments.tr: **Souvent oublié :** Les personnes qui ont plusieurs comptes, qui ont récemment changé de dépositaire ou qui ont hérité d'un compte en oublient parfois un.

segments.src: Ask each custodian whether an RMD is due and what amount they calculated.
segments.tr: Demandez à chaque dépositaire si une RMD est due et quel montant ils ont calculé.

segments.src: ## 3. Charitable Giving
segments.tr: ## 3. Dons de bienfaisance

segments.src: Donations made by December 31 may count toward your 2026 tax year, but the benefit depends on whether you itemize deductions.
segments.tr: Les dons effectués avant le 31 décembre peuvent compter pour votre année fiscale 2026, mais l'avantage dépend de si vous détaillez vos déductions.

segments.src: Points to consider:
segments.tr: Points à considérer :

segments.src: - **Itemizing vs. the standard deduction.** Most households take the standard deduction, which means a cash gift may not reduce taxes unless your total itemized deductions exceed it. Recent law changes have affected how charitable deductions work for different filers, so review the current rules for 2026.
segments.tr: - **Détail des déductions vs déduction standard.** La plupart des ménages prennent la déduction standard, ce qui signifie qu'un don en espèces peut ne pas réduire les impôts à moins que le total de vos déductions détaillées ne la dépasse. Les récents changements législatifs ont affecté le fonctionnement des déductions caritatives pour différents contribuables, vérifiez donc les règles actuelles pour 2026.

segments.src: - **Timing counts.** Generally, a gift is dated when you hand it over, for example when a check is mailed or a card charge is processed. Do not wait until the last day, since processing delays can push a gift into the next year.
segments.tr: - **Le timing compte.** Généralement, un don est daté au moment où vous le remettez, par exemple lorsqu'un chèque est envoyé par la poste ou qu'un paiement par carte est traité. N'attendez pas le dernier jour, car les délais de traitement peuvent repousser un don à l'année suivante.

segments.src: - **Keep records.** Save receipts or written acknowledgments, especially for larger gifts. Confirm that the organization is a qualifying charity.
segments.tr: - **Gardez des traces.** Conservez les reçus ou les accusés de réception écrits, surtout pour les dons importants. Confirmez que l'organisation est une œuvre de bienfaisance qualifiée.

segments.src: - **Appreciated assets.** Donating stock or other assets you have held for more than a year can sometimes let you avoid capital gains tax on the appreciation. Transfers take time, so start early.
segments.tr: - **Actifs appréciés.** Faire don d'actions ou d'autres actifs que vous détenez depuis plus d'un an peut parfois vous permettre d'éviter l'impôt sur les gains en capital sur la plus-value. Les transferts prennent du temps, alors commencez tôt.

segments.src: - **Qualified charitable distributions (QCDs).** If you are old enough (generally 70½ or older), you can send money directly from an IRA to a charity. A QCD can count toward your RMD while keeping the amount out of your taxable income. The money must go directly from the IRA to the charity.
segments.tr: - **Distributions caritatives qualifiées (QCD).** Si vous êtes assez âgé (généralement 70½ ans ou plus), vous pouvez envoyer de l'argent directement d'un IRA à une œuvre de bienfaisance. Une QCD peut compter pour votre RMD tout en gardant le montant hors de votre revenu imposable. L'argent doit aller directement de l'IRA à l'œuvre de bienfaisance.

segments.src: - **Donor-advised funds.** These let you make a gift in one year and recommend grants to charities later, which can help you bunch several years of giving into one tax year.
segments.tr: - **Fonds conseillés par les donateurs.** Ceux-ci vous permettent de faire un don une année et de recommander des subventions à des œuvres de bienfaisance plus tard, ce qui peut vous aider à regrouper plusieurs années de dons en une seule année fiscale.

segments.src: ## 4. Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
segments.tr: ## 4. Comptes d'épargne santé (HSA)

segments.src: HSAs differ from FSAs in one important way: the money generally stays yours and does not expire at year end.
segments.tr: Les HSA diffèrent des FSA sur un point important : l'argent reste généralement le vôtre et n'expire pas à la fin de l'année.

segments.src: However, some HSA-related deadlines still matter.
segments.tr: Cependant, certaines échéances liées aux HSA restent importantes.

segments.src: - **Eligibility.** You can contribute only if you are covered by a qualifying high-deductible health plan and have no disqualifying other coverage.
segments.tr: - **Éligibilité.** Vous ne pouvez cotiser que si vous êtes couvert par un régime de santé à franchise élevée qualifié et que vous n'avez aucune autre couverture disqualifiante.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits for self-only and family coverage, with an additional catch-up amount for those 55 and older. Check the 2026 figures before you contribute.
segments.tr: - **Limites de cotisation.** L'IRS fixe des limites annuelles pour la couverture individuelle et familiale, avec un montant de rattrapage supplémentaire pour les personnes de 55 ans et plus. Vérifiez les chiffres de 2026 avant de cotiser.

segments.src: - **Deadline.** Unlike many year-end items, you can usually make contributions for the tax year until the tax filing deadline the following April. Payroll contributions, however, must go through your employer during the year.
segments.tr: - **Échéance.** Contrairement à de nombreux éléments de fin d'année, vous pouvez généralement effectuer des cotisations pour l'année fiscale jusqu'à la date limite de déclaration d'impôts en avril suivant. Les cotisations sur salaire, cependant, doivent passer par votre employeur au cours de l'année.

segments.src: - **Don't overfund.** Contributing above the limit, including employer contributions, can trigger a tax penalty unless corrected.
segments.tr: - **Ne dépassez pas le plafond.** Cotiser au-delà de la limite, y compris les cotisations de l'employeur, peut déclencher une pénalité fiscale si ce n'est pas corrigé.

segments.src: - **Last-month rule.** In certain cases, being eligible in December can allow a full-year contribution, but it comes with a testing period. Understand the conditions before relying on it.
segments.tr: - **Règle du dernier mois.** Dans certains cas, être éligible en décembre peut permettre une cotisation pour toute l'année, mais cela s'accompagne d'une période de test. Comprenez les conditions avant de vous y fier.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Deadlines Worth a Quick Look
segments.tr: ## 5. Autres échéances qui méritent un coup d'œil rapide

segments.src: - **Open enrollment.** Many employer benefit elections, including FSA and HSA amounts, are set during open enrollment. Mark the deadline for choosing 2027 benefits.
segments.tr: - **Inscription ouverte.** De nombreux choix d'avantages sociaux de l'employeur, y compris les montants FSA et HSA, sont définis pendant l'inscription ouverte. Notez la date limite pour choisir les avantages de 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement plan contributions.** Contributions to a 401(k) generally have to be made through payroll by December 31, while IRA contributions can usually be made until the filing deadline in April. Check whether you are on track to reach your contribution goal and whether your employer match is fully captured.
segments.tr: - **Cotisations au régime de retraite.** Les cotisations à un 401(k) doivent généralement être effectuées par retenue sur salaire avant le 31 décembre, tandis que les cotisations IRA peuvent généralement être effectuées jusqu'à la date limite de déclaration en avril. Vérifiez si vous êtes en bonne voie d'atteindre votre objectif de cotisation et si l'abondement de votre employeur est pleinement capturé.

segments.src: - **Tax-loss harvesting.** Investors with taxable accounts sometimes sell losing positions to offset gains. Be aware of the wash-sale rule, which can disallow a loss if you buy back a substantially identical investment too soon.
segments.tr: - **Récolte de pertes fiscales.** Les investisseurs ayant des comptes imposables vendent parfois des positions perdantes pour compenser les gains. Soyez conscient de la règle du « wash-sale », qui peut invalider une perte si vous rachetez un investissement substantiellement identique trop tôt.

segments.src: - **Gift tax annual exclusion.** Gifts to individuals up to the annual limit generally do not require a gift tax return. The exclusion does not carry over to the next year.
segments.tr: - **Exclusion annuelle de la taxe sur les dons.** Les dons aux particuliers jusqu'à la limite annuelle ne nécessitent généralement pas de déclaration de taxe sur les dons. L'exclusion ne se reporte pas à l'année suivante.

segments.src: - **Estimated taxes.** If you have freelance, business or investment income, review whether you have paid enough during the year to avoid underpayment penalties.
segments.tr: - **Impôts estimés.** Si vous avez des revenus de travail indépendant, d'entreprise ou d'investissement, vérifiez si vous avez payé suffisamment au cours de l'année pour éviter les pénalités de sous-paiement.

segments.src: - **Insurance and plan reviews.** Check beneficiary designations, since outdated ones can override what you intend.
segments.tr: - **Révisions d'assurance et de régime.** Vérifiez les désignations de bénéficiaires, car celles qui sont obsolètes peuvent outrepasser ce que vous aviez prévu.

segments.src: ## A Simple Year-End Checklist
segments.tr: ## Une simple liste de contrôle de fin d'année

segments.src: 1. **This week:** Check FSA balances and your plan's carryover or grace-period policy.
segments.tr: 1. **Cette semaine :** Vérifiez les soldes FSA et la politique de report ou de période de grâce de votre régime.

segments.src: 2. **By mid-November:** Confirm whether you owe an RMD and contact each custodian.
segments.tr: 2. **D'ici mi-novembre :** Confirmez si vous devez une RMD et contactez chaque dépositaire.

segments.src: 3. **By early December:** Decide on charitable gifts and start any stock transfers.
segments.tr: 3. **D'ici début décembre :** Décidez des dons de bienfaisance et commencez tout transfert d'actions.

segments.src: 4. **Before December 31:** Make final payroll contribution changes where possible, and complete RMDs and any FSA spending.
segments.tr: 4. **Avant le 31 décembre :** Effectuez les derniers changements de cotisation sur salaire si possible, et complétez les RMD et toute dépense FSA.

segments.src: 5. **In January:** Gather tax documents and plan your HSA and IRA contributions for the prior year.
segments.tr: 5. **En janvier :** Rassemblez les documents fiscaux et planifiez vos cotisations HSA et IRA pour l'année précédente.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: Not every deadline applies to everyone.
segments.tr: Toutes les échéances ne s'appliquent pas à tout le monde.

segments.src: The costliest mistakes tend to be the quiet ones: a forgotten FSA balance, a missed RMD on a lesser-used account, or a donation that is processed too late.
segments.tr: Les erreurs les plus coûteuses ont tendance à être les plus silencieuses : un solde FSA oublié, une RMD manquée sur un compte moins utilisé, ou un don traité trop tard.

segments.src: A short review in the next few weeks can help you avoid unpleasant surprises.
segments.tr: Un court examen au cours des prochaines semaines peut vous aider à éviter les mauvaises surprises.

segments.src: When in doubt, check with your plan administrator or a tax professional, since limits and rules change from year to year.
segments.tr: En cas de doute, vérifiez auprès de l'administrateur de votre régime ou d'un professionnel de la fiscalité, car les limites et les règles changent d'année en année.

segments.tr: Alguns podem custar dinheiro real se perdidos, enquanto outros são opcionais, mas úteis.

segments.src: This guide covers which ones matter, who they apply to, and which are most often overlooked.
segments.tr: Este guia aborda quais importam, a quem se aplicam e quais são mais frequentemente negligenciados.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax, legal or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é de caráter informativo geral, e não uma consultoria fiscal, jurídica ou financeira.

segments.src: Rules vary by plan and personal situation, so confirm details with your plan administrator, the IRS, or a qualified professional.*
segments.tr: As regras variam de acordo com o plano e a situação pessoal, portanto confirme os detalhes com o administrador do seu plano, a Receita Federal ou um profissional qualificado.*

segments.src: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Check Your Plan's Rules
segments.tr: ## 1. Contas de Gastos Flexíveis (FSAs): Verifique as Regras do Seu Plano

segments.src: A health care FSA lets you set aside pre-tax money for eligible medical expenses.
segments.tr: Uma FSA de saúde permite que você reserve dinheiro isento de impostos para despesas médicas elegíveis.

segments.src: The classic drawback is the "use it or lose it" rule: money left unspent at the end of the plan year may be forfeited.
segments.tr: A desvantagem clássica é a regra "use ou perca": o dinheiro não gasto no final do ano do plano pode ser perdido.

segments.src: Employers can soften that rule in one of two ways, but they are not required to offer either:
segments.tr: Os empregadores podem abrandar essa regra de uma de duas maneiras, mas não são obrigados a oferecer nenhuma:

segments.src: - **Carryover:** Some plans let you roll over a limited amount into the next year. The IRS adjusts the maximum carryover annually, so check the current figure with your plan.
segments.tr: - **Transporte (Carryover):** Alguns planos permitem que você transfira uma quantidade limitada para o ano seguinte. A Receita Federal ajusta o transporte máximo anualmente, então verifique o valor atual com seu plano.

segments.src: - **Grace period:** Some plans give you extra time, up to two and a half months, to incur new expenses against last year's balance.
segments.tr: - **Período de carência (Grace period):** Alguns planos dão tempo extra, de até dois meses e meio, para incorrer em novas despesas contra o saldo do ano passado.

segments.src: A plan may offer one of these options, but not both.
segments.tr: Um plano pode oferecer uma dessas opções, mas não ambas.

segments.src: Many employers offer neither.
segments.tr: Muitos empregadores não oferecem nenhuma.

segments.src: **What to do now:**
segments.tr: **O que fazer agora:**

segments.src: - Log in to your FSA portal and check your remaining balance and your plan's deadline.
segments.tr: - Faça login no seu portal FSA e verifique seu saldo restante e o prazo do seu plano.

segments.src: - Find out whether your plan uses a carryover, a grace period, or nothing.
segments.tr: - Descubra se o seu plano usa transporte, período de carência ou nenhum dos dois.

segments.src: - Look at the claims run-out deadline. Even if you incur an expense on time, you usually must submit the claim by a set date.
segments.tr: - Olhe o prazo limite para envio de sinistros. Mesmo que você incorre em uma despesa a tempo, geralmente deve enviar o sinistro até uma data definida.

segments.src: - Spend wisely. Eligible items often include prescription copays, dental work, vision exams and glasses, and many over-the-counter products. Check your plan's eligibility list before buying.
segments.tr: - Gaste com sabedoria. Itens elegíveis frequentemente incluem copagtos de receitas, atendimento odontológico, exames de vista e óculos, e muitos produtos sem receita. Verifique a lista de elegibilidade do seu plano antes de comprar.

segments.src: Dependent care FSAs follow their own rules and often do not allow carryover, so check them separately.
segments.tr: As FSAs de cuidados com dependentes seguem suas próprias regras e frequentemente não permitem transporte, portanto verifique-as separadamente.

segments.src: ## 2. Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
segments.tr: ## 2. Distribuições Mínimas Obrigatórias (RMDs)

segments.src: If you hold a traditional IRA or most employer retirement plans, the government eventually requires you to start withdrawing money.
segments.tr: Se você possui um IRA tradicional ou a maioria dos planos de previdência do empregador, o governo eventualmente exige que você comece a retirar dinheiro.

segments.src: These withdrawals are called required minimum distributions.
segments.tr: Essas retiradas são chamadas de distribuições mínimas obrigatórias.

segments.src: Under current federal law, the starting age depends on your birth year.
segments.tr: Sob a lei federal atual, a idade inicial depende do seu ano de nascimento.

segments.src: It is 73 for many people today and rises to 75 for those born in 1960 or later.
segments.tr: É 73 para muitas pessoas hoje e sobe para 75 para aqueles nascidos em 1960 ou depois.

segments.src: Confirm your own age requirement with the IRS or a tax professional.
segments.tr: Confirme seu próprio requisito de idade com a Receita Federal ou um profissional fiscal.

segments.src: Key points:
segments.tr: Pontos-chave:

segments.src: - **The annual deadline is generally December 31.** Your first RMD is the exception: you may delay it until April 1 of the following year. Delaying means you take two distributions in one calendar year, which can push you into a higher tax bracket.
segments.tr: - **O prazo anual é geralmente 31 de dezembro.** Sua primeira RMD é a exceção: você pode adiá-la até 1 de abril do ano seguinte. Atrasar significa que você faz duas distribuições em um ano civil, o que pode empurrá-lo para uma faixa de imposto mais alta.

segments.src: - **Missing an RMD carries a penalty.** The excise tax on a missed amount has been reduced in recent years, but it is still significant. The IRS may waive it if you show reasonable cause and correct the shortfall promptly.
segments.tr: - **Perder uma RMD acarreta uma penalidade.** O imposto especial de consumo sobre um valor perdido foi reduzido nos últimos anos, mas ainda é significativo. A Receita Federal pode dispensá-lo se você apresentar uma causa razoável e corrigir o déficit prontamente.

segments.src: - **Calculations are done per account type.** Traditional IRAs can often be aggregated, so you may take the total from one account. Employer plans such as 401(k)s generally must be calculated and withdrawn separately.
segments.tr: - **Os cálculos são feitos por tipo de conta.** IRAs tradicionais muitas vezes podem ser agregados, então você pode pegar o total de uma conta. Planos de empregador como 401(k)s geralmente devem ser calculados e retirados separadamente.

segments.src: - **Inherited accounts have their own rules.** Many beneficiaries must empty inherited retirement accounts within a set number of years, and some must also take annual distributions. This area is complicated and frequently misunderstood.
segments.tr: - **Contas herdadas têm suas próprias regras.** Muitos beneficiários devem esvaziar contas de previdência herdadas dentro de um número definido de anos, e alguns também devem fazer distribuições anuais. Esta área é complicada e frequentemente mal compreendida.

segments.src: Roth IRAs do not require withdrawals during the original owner's lifetime.
segments.tr: IRAs Roth não exigem retiradas durante a vida do proprietário original.

segments.src: **Commonly missed:** People who have several accounts, who recently changed custodians, or who inherited an account sometimes overlook one of them.
segments.tr: **Frequentemente esquecido:** Pessoas que têm várias contas, que mudaram recentemente de custodiante ou que herdaram uma conta às vezes esquecem uma delas.

segments.src: Ask each custodian whether an RMD is due and what amount they calculated.
segments.tr: Pergunte a cada custodiante se uma RMD é devida e qual valor eles calcularam.

segments.src: ## 3. Charitable Giving
segments.tr: ## 3. Doações de Caridade

segments.src: Donations made by December 31 may count toward your 2026 tax year, but the benefit depends on whether you itemize deductions.
segments.tr: Doações feitas até 31 de dezembro podem contar para o seu ano fiscal de 2026, mas o benefício depende de você detalhar as deduções.

segments.src: Points to consider:
segments.tr: Pontos a considerar:

segments.src: - **Itemizing vs. the standard deduction.** Most households take the standard deduction, which means a cash gift may not reduce taxes unless your total itemized deductions exceed it. Recent law changes have affected how charitable deductions work for different filers, so review the current rules for 2026.
segments.tr: - **Detalhar vs. dedução padrão.** A maioria das famílias usa a dedução padrão, o que significa que um presente em dinheiro pode não reduzir impostos a menos que suas deduções detalhadas totais o excedam. Mudanças recentes na lei afetaram como as deduções de caridade funcionam para diferentes contribuintes, portanto, revise as regras atuais para 2026.

segments.src: - **Timing counts.** Generally, a gift is dated when you hand it over, for example when a check is mailed or a card charge is processed. Do not wait until the last day, since processing delays can push a gift into the next year.
segments.tr: - **O timing conta.** Geralmente, um presente é datado quando você o entrega, por exemplo, quando um cheque é enviado pelo correio ou uma cobrança de cartão é processada. Não espere até o último dia, pois atrasos no processamento podem empurrar um presente para o próximo ano.

segments.src: - **Keep records.** Save receipts or written acknowledgments, especially for larger gifts. Confirm that the organization is a qualifying charity.
segments.tr: - **Guarde registros.** Salve recibos ou reconhecimentos por escrito, especialmente para presentes maiores. Confirme que a organização é uma instituição de caridade qualificada.

segments.src: - **Appreciated assets.** Donating stock or other assets you have held for more than a year can sometimes let you avoid capital gains tax on the appreciation. Transfers take time, so start early.
segments.tr: - **Ativos valorizados.** Doar ações ou outros ativos que você possui há mais de um ano às vezes pode permitir que você evite o imposto sobre ganhos de capital sobre a valorização. As transferências levam tempo, então comece cedo.

segments.src: - **Qualified charitable distributions (QCDs).** If you are old enough (generally 70½ or older), you can send money directly from an IRA to a charity. A QCD can count toward your RMD while keeping the amount out of your taxable income. The money must go directly from the IRA to the charity.
segments.tr: - **Distribuições de caridade qualificadas (QCDs).** Se você tiver idade suficiente (geralmente 70½ ou mais), você pode enviar dinheiro diretamente de um IRA para uma instituição de caridade. Um QCD pode contar para a sua RMD, mantendo o valor fora da sua renda tributável. O dinheiro deve ir diretamente do IRA para a instituição de caridade.

segments.src: - **Donor-advised funds.** These let you make a gift in one year and recommend grants to charities later, which can help you bunch several years of giving into one tax year.
segments.tr: - **Fundos orientados por doadores.** Estes permitem que você faça uma doação em um ano e recomende doações para instituições de caridade mais tarde, o que pode ajudá-lo a agrupar vários anos de doação em um único ano fiscal.

segments.src: ## 4. Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
segments.tr: ## 4. Contas Poupança de Saúde (HSAs)

segments.src: HSAs differ from FSAs in one important way: the money generally stays yours and does not expire at year end.
segments.tr: As HSAs diferem das FSAs de uma maneira importante: o dinheiro geralmente continua sendo seu e não expira no final do ano.

segments.src: However, some HSA-related deadlines still matter.
segments.tr: No entanto, alguns prazos relacionados a HSA ainda importam.

segments.src: - **Eligibility.** You can contribute only if you are covered by a qualifying high-deductible health plan and have no disqualifying other coverage.
segments.tr: - **Elegibilidade.** Você pode contribuir apenas se estiver coberto por um plano de saúde qualificado de alta franquia e não tiver outra cobertura desqualificante.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits for self-only and family coverage, with an additional catch-up amount for those 55 and older. Check the 2026 figures before you contribute.
segments.tr: - **Limites de contribuição.** A Receita Federal define limites anuais para cobertura individual e familiar, com um valor adicional de recuperação para aqueles com 55 anos ou mais. Verifique os números de 2026 antes de contribuir.

segments.src: - **Deadline.** Unlike many year-end items, you can usually make contributions for the tax year until the tax filing deadline the following April. Payroll contributions, however, must go through your employer during the year.
segments.tr: - **Prazo.** Ao contrário de muitos itens de fim de ano, você geralmente pode fazer contribuições para o ano fiscal até o prazo de entrega de impostos em abril seguinte. As contribuições de folha de pagamento, no entanto, devem passar pelo seu empregador durante o ano.

segments.src: - **Don't overfund.** Contributing above the limit, including employer contributions, can trigger a tax penalty unless corrected.
segments.tr: - **Não financie excessivamente.** Contribuir acima do limite, incluindo contribuições do empregador, pode desencadear uma penalidade fiscal a menos que seja corrigido.

segments.src: - **Last-month rule.** In certain cases, being eligible in December can allow a full-year contribution, but it comes with a testing period. Understand the conditions before relying on it.
segments.tr: - **Regra do último mês.** Em certos casos, ser elegível em dezembro pode permitir uma contribuição de ano inteiro, mas vem com um período de teste. Entenda as condições antes de confiar nisso.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Deadlines Worth a Quick Look
segments.tr: ## 5. Outros Prazos que Valem uma Rápida Olhada

segments.src: - **Open enrollment.** Many employer benefit elections, including FSA and HSA amounts, are set during open enrollment. Mark the deadline for choosing 2027 benefits.
segments.tr: - **Inscrição aberta.** Muitas eleições de benefícios do empregador, incluindo valores de FSA e HSA, são definidas durante a inscrição aberta. Marque o prazo para escolher os benefícios de 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement plan contributions.** Contributions to a 401(k) generally have to be made through payroll by December 31, while IRA contributions can usually be made until the filing deadline in April. Check whether you are on track to reach your contribution goal and whether your employer match is fully captured.
segments.tr: - **Contribuições para o plano de aposentadoria.** Contribuições para um 401(k) geralmente precisam ser feitas por folha de pagamento até 31 de dezembro, enquanto contribuições para IRA geralmente podem ser feitas até o prazo de entrega em abril. Verifique se você está no caminho certo para atingir sua meta de contribuição e se a contrapartida do seu empregador está totalmente capturada.

segments.src: - **Tax-loss harvesting.** Investors with taxable accounts sometimes sell losing positions to offset gains. Be aware of the wash-sale rule, which can disallow a loss if you buy back a substantially identical investment too soon.
segments.tr: - **Colheita de prejuízos fiscais.** Investidores com contas tributáveis às vezes vendem posições com prejuízo para compensar ganhos. Esteja ciente da regra de venda wash-sale, que pode desconsiderar uma perda se você comprar de volta um investimento substancialmente idêntico muito cedo.

segments.src: - **Gift tax annual exclusion.** Gifts to individuals up to the annual limit generally do not require a gift tax return. The exclusion does not carry over to the next year.
segments.tr: - **Exclusão anual do imposto sobre doações.** Doações a indivíduos até o limite anual geralmente não exigem uma declaração de imposto sobre doações. A exclusão não transita para o próximo ano.

segments.src: - **Estimated taxes.** If you have freelance, business or investment income, review whether you have paid enough during the year to avoid underpayment penalties.
segments.tr: - **Impostos estimados.** Se você tiver renda autônoma, empresarial ou de investimentos, revise se pagou o suficiente durante o ano para evitar penalidades por pagamento insuficiente.

segments.src: - **Insurance and plan reviews.** Check beneficiary designations, since outdated ones can override what you intend.
segments.tr: - **Seguros e revisões de planos.** Verifique as designações de beneficiários, já que as desatualizadas podem anular o que você pretende.

segments.src: ## A Simple Year-End Checklist
segments.tr: ## Uma Simples Lista de Verificação de Fim de Ano

segments.src: 1. **This week:** Check FSA balances and your plan's carryover or grace-period policy.
segments.tr: 1. **Esta semana:** Verifique os saldos de FSA e a política de transporte ou período de carência do seu plano.

segments.src: 2. **By mid-November:** Confirm whether you owe an RMD and contact each custodian.
segments.tr: 2. **Até meados de novembro:** Confirme se você deve uma RMD e entre em contato com cada custodiante.

segments.src: 3. **By early December:** Decide on charitable gifts and start any stock transfers.
segments.tr: 3. **Até o início de dezembro:** Decida sobre doações de caridade e inicie quaisquer transferências de ações.

segments.src: 4. **Before December 31:** Make final payroll contribution changes where possible, and complete RMDs and any FSA spending.
segments.tr: 4. **Antes de 31 de dezembro:** Faça alterações finais de contribuição de folha de pagamento onde possível, e conclua RMDs e qualquer gasto de FSA.

segments.src: 5. **In January:** Gather tax documents and plan your HSA and IRA contributions for the prior year.
segments.tr: 5. **Em janeiro:** Reúna documentos fiscais e planeje suas contribuições para HSA e IRA para o ano anterior.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: Not every deadline applies to everyone.
segments.tr: Nem todo prazo se aplica a todos.

segments.src: The costliest mistakes tend to be the quiet ones: a forgotten FSA balance, a missed RMD on a lesser-used account, or a donation that is processed too late.
segments.tr: Os erros mais custosos tendem a ser os silenciosos: um saldo de FSA esquecido, uma RMD perdida em uma conta pouco usada, ou uma doação que é processada tarde demais.

segments.src: A short review in the next few weeks can help you avoid unpleasant surprises.
segments.tr: Uma breve revisão nas próximas semanas pode ajudá-lo a evitar surpresas desagradáveis.

segments.src: When in doubt, check with your plan administrator or a tax professional, since limits and rules change from year to year.
segments.tr: Em caso de dúvida, consulte o administrador do seu plano ou um profissional fiscal, já que limites e regras mudam de ano para ano.

segments.src: With roughly two months left in 2026, now is a practical time to review a handful of money deadlines that fall on or near December 31.
segments.tr: Dengan sisa waktu sekitar dua bulan di tahun 2026, sekarang adalah waktu yang tepat untuk meninjau beberapa tenggat waktu keuangan yang jatuh tempo pada atau sekitar 31 Desember.

segments.src: This guide covers which ones matter, who they apply to, and which are most often overlooked.
segments.tr: Panduan ini mencakup mana yang penting, kepada siapa hal tersebut berlaku, dan mana yang paling sering terlewatkan.

segments.src: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Check Your Plan's Rules
segments.tr: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Periksa Aturan Program Anda

segments.src: A health care FSA lets you set aside pre-tax money for eligible medical expenses.
segments.tr: FSA perawatan kesehatan memungkinkan Anda menyisihkan uang sebelum pajak untuk biaya medis yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: The classic drawback is the "use it or lose it" rule: money left unspent at the end of the plan year may be forfeited.
segments.tr: Kekurangan klise adalah aturan "gunakan atau hilangkan": uang yang tidak dihabiskan pada akhir tahun program dapat hangus.

segments.src: Employers can soften that rule in one of two ways, but they are not required to offer either:
segments.tr: Pemberi kerja dapat melonggarkan aturan tersebut dengan salah satu dari dua cara, tetapi mereka tidak wajib menawarkan keduanya:

segments.src: - **Carryover:** Some plans let you roll over a limited amount into the next year. The IRS adjusts the maximum carryover annually, so check the current figure with your plan.
segments.tr: - **Carryover:** Beberapa program memungkinkan Anda menggulirkan jumlah terbatas ke tahun berikutnya. IRS menyesuaikan jumlah maksimum carryover setiap tahun, jadi periksa angka saat ini dengan program Anda.

segments.src: - **Grace period:** Some plans give you extra time, up to two and a half months, to incur new expenses against last year's balance.
segments.tr: - **Grace period:** Beberapa program memberi Anda waktu tambahan, hingga dua setengah bulan, untuk menanggung biaya baru terhadap saldo tahun lalu.

segments.src: A plan may offer one of these options, but not both.
segments.tr: Suatu program dapat menawarkan salah satu opsi ini, tetapi tidak keduanya.

segments.src: Many employers offer neither.
segments.tr: Banyak pemberi kerja yang tidak menawarkan keduanya.

segments.src: **What to do now:**
segments.tr: **Yang harus dilakukan sekarang:**

segments.src: - Log in to your FSA portal and check your remaining balance and your plan's deadline.
segments.tr: - Masuk ke portal FSA Anda dan periksa sisa saldo serta tenggat waktu program Anda.

segments.src: - Find out whether your plan uses a carryover, a grace period, or nothing.
segments.tr: - Cari tahu apakah program Anda menggunakan carryover, grace period, atau tidak sama sekali.

segments.src: - Look at the claims run-out deadline. Even if you incur an expense on time, you usually must submit the claim by a set date.
segments.tr: - Perhatikan tenggat waktu pengajuan klaim (claims run-out). Bahkan jika Anda mengeluarkan biaya tepat waktu, Anda biasanya harus mengirimkan klaim paling lambat pada tanggal yang ditentukan.

segments.src: - Spend wisely. Eligible items often include prescription copays, dental work, vision exams and glasses, and many over-the-counter products. Check your plan's eligibility list before buying.
segments.tr: - Belanja dengan bijak. Barang yang memenuhi syarat sering kali mencakup copay resep, perawatan gigi, pemeriksaan mata dan kacamata, serta banyak produk yang dijual bebas (over-the-counter). Periksa daftar kelayakan program Anda sebelum membeli.

segments.src: Dependent care FSAs follow their own rules and often do not allow carryover, so check them separately.
segments.tr: FSA perawatan tanggungan mengikuti aturan mereka sendiri dan sering kali tidak mengizinkan carryover, jadi periksa secara terpisah.

segments.src: ## 2. Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
segments.tr: ## 2. Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)

segments.src: If you hold a traditional IRA or most employer retirement plans, the government eventually requires you to start withdrawing money.
segments.tr: Jika Anda memiliki IRA tradisional atau sebagian besar program pensiun pemberi kerja, pemerintah pada akhirnya mewajibkan Anda untuk mulai menarik uang.

segments.src: These withdrawals are called required minimum distributions.
segments.tr: Penarikan ini disebut distribusi minimum yang disyaratkan.

segments.src: Under current federal law, the starting age depends on your birth year.
