segments.tr: Berdasarkan undang-undang federal saat ini, usia awal tergantung pada tahun lahir Anda.

segments.src: It is 73 for many people today and rises to 75 for those born in 1960 or later.
segments.tr: Usianya adalah 73 tahun bagi banyak orang saat ini dan naik menjadi 75 tahun bagi mereka yang lahir pada tahun 1960 atau setelahnya.

segments.src: Confirm your own age requirement with the IRS or a tax professional.
segments.tr: Konfirmasikan persyaratan usia Anda sendiri dengan IRS atau profesional pajak.

segments.src: Key points:
segments.tr: Poin-poin penting:

segments.src: - **The annual deadline is generally December 31.** Your first RMD is the exception: you may delay it until April 1 of the following year. Delaying means you take two distributions in one calendar year, which can push you into a higher tax bracket.
segments.tr: - **Tenggat waktu tahunan umumnya adalah 31 Desember.** RMD pertama Anda adalah pengecualian: Anda dapat menundanya hingga 1 April tahun berikutnya. Penundaan berarti Anda mengambil dua distribusi dalam satu tahun kalender, yang dapat mendorong Anda ke golongan pajak yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: - **Missing an RMD carries a penalty.** The excise tax on a missed amount has been reduced in recent years, but it is still significant. The IRS may waive it if you show reasonable cause and correct the shortfall promptly.
segments.tr: - **Melewatkan RMD dikenakan denda.** Pajak cukai atas jumlah yang terlewat telah dikurangi dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, tetapi masih cukup besar. IRS dapat menghapusnya jika Anda menunjukkan alasan yang masuk akal dan memperbaiki kekurangan tersebut dengan segera.

segments.src: - **Calculations are done per account type.** Traditional IRAs can often be aggregated, so you may take the total from one account. Employer plans such as 401(k)s generally must be calculated and withdrawn separately.
segments.tr: - **Perhitungan dilakukan per jenis akun.** IRA tradisional sering kali dapat digabungkan, sehingga Anda dapat mengambil total dari satu akun. Program pemberi kerja seperti 401(k) umumnya harus dihitung dan ditarik secara terpisah.

segments.src: - **Inherited accounts have their own rules.** Many beneficiaries must empty inherited retirement accounts within a set number of years, and some must also take annual distributions. This area is complicated and frequently misunderstood.
segments.tr: - **Akun warisan memiliki aturan sendiri.** Banyak penerima manfaat harus mengosongkan akun pensiun warisan dalam jumlah tahun tertentu, dan beberapa juga harus mengambil distribusi tahunan. Area ini rumit dan sering disalahpahami.

segments.src: Roth IRAs do not require withdrawals during the original owner's lifetime.
segments.tr: Roth IRA tidak memerlukan penarikan selama masa hidup pemilik asli.

segments.src: **Commonly missed:** People who have several accounts, who recently changed custodians, or who inherited an account sometimes overlook one of them.
segments.tr: **Sering terlewatkan:** Orang yang memiliki beberapa akun, yang baru saja mengganti kustodian, atau yang mewarisi akun terkadang mengabaikan salah satunya.

segments.src: Ask each custodian whether an RMD is due and what amount they calculated.
segments.tr: Tanyakan kepada setiap kustodian apakah RMD jatuh tempo dan berapa jumlah yang mereka hitung.

segments.src: ## 3. Charitable Giving
segments.tr: ## 3. Pemberian Amal

segments.src: Donations made by December 31 may count toward your 2026 tax year, but the benefit depends on whether you itemize deductions.
segments.tr: Donasi yang dilakukan paling lambat 31 Desember dapat dihitung untuk tahun pajak 2026 Anda, tetapi manfaatnya bergantung pada apakah Anda merinci potongan (itemize deductions).

segments.src: Points to consider:
segments.tr: Hal yang perlu dipertimbangkan:

segments.src: - **Itemizing vs. the standard deduction.** Most households take the standard deduction, which means a cash gift may not reduce taxes unless your total itemized deductions exceed it. Recent law changes have affected how charitable deductions work for different filers, so review the current rules for 2026.
segments.tr: - **Merinci vs. potongan standar.** Sebagian besar rumah tangga mengambil potongan standar, yang berarti pemberian tunai mungkin tidak mengurangi pajak kecuali total potongan terperinci Anda melebihi jumlah tersebut. Perubahan undang-undang baru-baru ini telah memengaruhi cara kerja potongan amal untuk berbagai Wajib Pajak, jadi tinjau aturan saat ini untuk tahun 2026.

segments.src: - **Timing counts.** Generally, a gift is dated when you hand it over, for example when a check is mailed or a card charge is processed. Do not wait until the last day, since processing delays can push a gift into the next year.
segments.tr: - **Waktu sangat penting.** Umumnya, hadiah diberi tanggal saat Anda menyerahkannya, misalnya ketika cek dikirimkan atau transaksi kartu diproses. Jangan menunggu sampai hari terakhir, karena penundaan pemrosesan dapat mendorong hadiah ke tahun berikutnya.

segments.src: - **Keep records.** Save receipts or written acknowledgments, especially for larger gifts. Confirm that the organization is a qualifying charity.
segments.tr: - **Simpan catatan.** Simpan tanda terima atau pengakuan tertulis, terutama untuk hadiah yang lebih besar. Konfirmasikan bahwa organisasi tersebut adalah badan amal yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: - **Appreciated assets.** Donating stock or other assets you have held for more than a year can sometimes let you avoid capital gains tax on the appreciation. Transfers take time, so start early.
segments.tr: - **Aset yang mengalami apresiasi.** Mendonasikan saham atau aset lain yang telah Anda miliki selama lebih dari satu tahun terkadang dapat membantu Anda menghindari pajak keuntungan modal atas apresiasi tersebut. Transfer membutuhkan waktu, jadi mulailah lebih awal.

segments.src: - **Qualified charitable distributions (QCDs).** If you are old enough (generally 70½ or older), you can send money directly from an IRA to a charity. A QCD can count toward your RMD while keeping the amount out of your taxable income. The money must go directly from the IRA to the charity.
segments.tr: - **Qualified charitable distributions (QCDs).** Jika usia Anda sudah cukup (umumnya 70½ tahun atau lebih), Anda dapat mengirim uang langsung dari IRA ke badan amal. QCD dapat diperhitungkan sebagai RMD Anda sekaligus menjaga agar jumlah tersebut tidak masuk ke dalam penghasilan kena pajak Anda. Uang tersebut harus mengalir langsung dari IRA ke badan amal.

segments.src: - **Donor-advised funds.** These let you make a gift in one year and recommend grants to charities later, which can help you bunch several years of giving into one tax year.
segments.tr: - **Dana yang diarahkan donor (Donor-advised funds).** Ini memungkinkan Anda memberikan sumbangan dalam satu tahun dan merekomendasikan hibah ke badan amal di kemudian hari, yang dapat membantu Anda menggabungkan beberapa tahun pemberian ke dalam satu tahun pajak.

segments.src: ## 4. Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
segments.tr: ## 4. Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)

segments.src: HSAs differ from FSAs in one important way: the money generally stays yours and does not expire at year end.
segments.tr: HSA berbeda dari FSA dalam satu hal penting: uang tersebut umumnya tetap menjadi milik Anda dan tidak kedaluwarsa pada akhir tahun.

segments.src: However, some HSA-related deadlines still matter.
segments.tr: Namun, beberapa tenggat waktu yang berkaitan dengan HSA tetap penting.

segments.src: - **Eligibility.** You can contribute only if you are covered by a qualifying high-deductible health plan and have no disqualifying other coverage.
segments.tr: - **Kelayakan.** Anda dapat berkontribusi hanya jika Anda dicakup oleh rencana kesehatan dengan deductible tinggi yang memenuhi syarat dan tidak memiliki cakupan lain yang mendiskualifikasi.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits for self-only and family coverage, with an additional catch-up amount for those 55 and older. Check the 2026 figures before you contribute.
segments.tr: - **Batas kontribusi.** IRS menetapkan batas tahunan untuk cakupan mandiri dan keluarga, dengan jumlah tambahan catch-up bagi mereka yang berusia 55 tahun ke atas. Periksa angka tahun 2026 sebelum Anda berkontribusi.

segments.src: - **Deadline.** Unlike many year-end items, you can usually make contributions for the tax year until the tax filing deadline the following April. Payroll contributions, however, must go through your employer during the year.
segments.tr: - **Tenggat waktu.** Tidak seperti banyak item akhir tahun, Anda biasanya dapat melakukan kontribusi untuk tahun pajak hingga tenggat waktu pengajuan pajak pada bulan April berikutnya. Namun, kontribusi melalui pemotongan gaji harus melalui pemberi kerja Anda selama tahun berjalan.

segments.src: - **Don't overfund.** Contributing above the limit, including employer contributions, can trigger a tax penalty unless corrected.
segments.tr: - **Jangan mendanai secara berlebihan.** Berkontribusi di atas batas, termasuk kontribusi pemberi kerja, dapat memicu denda pajak kecuali dikoreksi.

segments.src: - **Last-month rule.** In certain cases, being eligible in December can allow a full-year contribution, but it comes with a testing period. Understand the conditions before relying on it.
segments.tr: - **Aturan bulan terakhir.** Dalam kasus tertentu, memenuhi syarat pada bulan Desember dapat memungkinkan kontribusi setahun penuh, tetapi hal itu disertai dengan periode pengujian. Pahami persyaratannya sebelum mengandalkannya.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Deadlines Worth a Quick Look
segments.tr: ## 5. Tenggat Waktu Lain yang Layak Dilihat Sekilas

segments.src: - **Open enrollment.** Many employer benefit elections, including FSA and HSA amounts, are set during open enrollment. Mark the deadline for choosing 2027 benefits.
segments.tr: - **Pendaftaran terbuka (Open enrollment).** Banyak pilihan benefit pemberi kerja, termasuk jumlah FSA dan HSA, ditetapkan selama pendaftaran terbuka. Tandai tenggat waktu untuk memilih benefit tahun 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement plan contributions.** Contributions to a 401(k) generally have to be made through payroll by December 31, while IRA contributions can usually be made until the filing deadline in April. Check whether you are on track to reach your contribution goal and whether your employer match is fully captured.
segments.tr: - **Kontribusi program pensiun.** Kontribusi ke 401(k) umumnya harus dilakukan melalui pemotongan gaji paling lambat 31 Desember, sementara kontribusi IRA biasanya dapat dilakukan hingga tenggat waktu pengajuan pada bulan April. Periksa apakah Anda berada di jalur yang benar untuk mencapai target kontribusi Anda dan apakah kecocokan pemberi kerja (employer match) Anda telah sepenuhnya diambil.

segments.src: - **Tax-loss harvesting.** Investors with taxable accounts sometimes sell losing positions to offset gains. Be aware of the wash-sale rule, which can disallow a loss if you buy back a substantially identical investment too soon.
segments.tr: - **Panen rugi pajak (Tax-loss harvesting).** Investor dengan akun kena pajak terkadang menjual posisi yang merugi untuk mengimbangi keuntungan. Waspadai aturan wash-sale, yang dapat menolak kerugian jika Anda membeli kembali investasi yang secara substansial identik terlalu cepat.

segments.src: - **Gift tax annual exclusion.** Gifts to individuals up to the annual limit generally do not require a gift tax return. The exclusion does not carry over to the next year.
segments.tr: - **Pengecualian tahunan pajak hadiah.** Hadiah kepada individu hingga batas tahunan umumnya tidak memerlukan pelaporan pajak hadiah. Pengecualian tersebut tidak diteruskan ke tahun berikutnya.

segments.src: - **Estimated taxes.** If you have freelance, business or investment income, review whether you have paid enough during the year to avoid underpayment penalties.
segments.tr: - **Pajak estimasi.** Jika Anda memiliki penghasilan freelance, bisnis, atau investasi, tinjau apakah Anda telah membayar cukup selama tahun tersebut untuk menghindari denda kekurangan pembayaran.

segments.src: - **Insurance and plan reviews.** Check beneficiary designations, since outdated ones can override what you intend.
segments.tr: - **Tinjauan asuransi dan program.** Periksa penunjukan penerima manfaat, karena yang sudah kedaluwarsa dapat mengesampingkan apa yang Anda maksudkan.

segments.src: ## A Simple Year-End Checklist
segments.tr: ## Daftar Periksa Sederhana Akhir Tahun

segments.src: 1. **This week:** Check FSA balances and your plan's carryover or grace-period policy.
segments.tr: 1. **Minggu ini:** Periksa saldo FSA dan kebijakan carryover atau grace period program Anda.

segments.src: 2. **By mid-November:** Confirm whether you owe an RMD and contact each custodian.
segments.tr: 2. **Pertengahan November:** Konfirmasikan apakah Anda memiliki kewajiban RMD dan hubungi setiap kustodian.

segments.src: 3. **By early December:** Decide on charitable gifts and start any stock transfers.
segments.tr: 3. **Awal Desember:** Putuskan hadiah amal dan mulai transfer saham apa pun.

segments.src: 4. **Before December 31:** Make final payroll contribution changes where possible, and complete RMDs and any FSA spending.
segments.tr: 4. **Sebelum 31 Desember:** Buat perubahan kontribusi gaji akhir jika memungkinkan, dan selesaikan RMD serta pengeluaran FSA apa pun.

segments.src: 5. **In January:** Gather tax documents and plan your HSA and IRA contributions for the prior year.
segments.tr: 5. **Pada bulan Januari:** Kumpulkan dokumen pajak dan rencanakan kontribusi HSA dan IRA Anda untuk tahun sebelumnya.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: Not every deadline applies to everyone.
segments.tr: Tidak semua tenggat waktu berlaku untuk semua orang.

segments.src: The costliest mistakes tend to be the quiet ones: a forgotten FSA balance, a missed RMD on a lesser-used account, or a donation that is processed too late.
segments.tr: Kesalahan yang paling merugikan cenderung adalah kesalahan yang tidak disadari: saldo FSA yang terlupakan, RMD yang terlewat pada akun yang jarang digunakan, atau donasi yang diproses terlalu terlambat.

segments.src: A short review in the next few weeks can help you avoid unpleasant surprises.
segments.tr: Tinjauan singkat dalam beberapa minggu ke depan dapat membantu Anda menghindari kejutan yang tidak menyenangkan.

segments.src: When in doubt, check with your plan administrator or a tax professional, since limits and rules change from year to year.
segments.tr: Jika ragu, tanyakan kepada administrator program Anda atau profesional pajak, karena batas dan aturan berubah dari tahun ke tahun.

ja.title: 使わなければ消滅：12月31日前に確認すべき年末の金銭的期限

segments.src: With roughly two months left in 2026, now is a practical time to review a handful of money deadlines that fall on or near December 31.
segments.tr: 2026年も残り約2か月となった今、12月31日またはその前後が期限となるいくつかの金銭的期限を見直すのに適した時期です。

segments.src: Some can cost you real money if missed, while others are optional but useful.
segments.tr: 見逃すと実際に金銭的損失を被るものもあれば、任意ですが役立つものもあります。

segments.src: This guide covers which ones matter, who they apply to, and which are most often overlooked.
segments.tr: このガイドでは、どの期限が重要か、誰に適用されるか、そしてどれが最も見落とされやすいかを取り上げます。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax, legal or financial advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報提供であり、税務、法的、または財務上の助言ではありません。

segments.src: Rules vary by plan and personal situation, so confirm details with your plan administrator, the IRS, or a qualified professional.*
segments.tr: ルールはプランや個人の状況によって異なるため、詳細についてはプラン管理者、IRS（米国内国歳入庁）、または資格を持つ専門家にご確認ください.*

segments.src: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Check Your Plan's Rules
segments.tr: ## 1. 医療費フレキシブル支出口座（FSA）：プランのルールを確認する

segments.src: A health care FSA lets you set aside pre-tax money for eligible medical expenses.
segments.tr: 医療費FSAを利用すると、対象となる医療費のために税引前のお金を積み立てることができます。

segments.src: The classic drawback is the "use it or lose it" rule: money left unspent at the end of the plan year may be forfeited.
segments.tr: 典型的な欠点は「使わなければ消滅（use it or lose it）」ルールです。プラン年度の末日までに使い切らなかったお金は没収される可能性があります。

segments.src: Employers can soften that rule in one of two ways, but they are not required to offer either:
segments.tr: 雇用主は2つの方法のいずれかでそのルールを緩和することができますが、どちらかを提供することが義務付けられているわけではありません：

segments.src: - **Carryover:** Some plans let you roll over a limited amount into the next year. The IRS adjusts the maximum carryover annually, so check the current figure with your plan.
segments.tr: - **繰り越し（Carryover）：** 一部のプランでは、限度額まで翌年に繰り越すことができます。IRSは年ごとに最大繰越額を調整するため、現在の金額をプランにご確認ください。

segments.src: - **Grace period:** Some plans give you extra time, up to two and a half months, to incur new expenses against last year's balance.
segments.tr: - **猶予期間（Grace period）：** 一部のプランでは、昨年の残高に対して新しい費用を発生させるための追加の期間（最長2か月半）が与えられます。

segments.src: A plan may offer one of these options, but not both.
segments.tr: プランはいずれかのオプションを提供する場合が​​ありますが、両方を提供することはありません。

segments.src: Many employers offer neither.
segments.tr: 多くの雇用主はどちらも提供していません。

segments.src: **What to do now:**
segments.tr: **今すべきこと：**

segments.src: - Log in to your FSA portal and check your remaining balance and your plan's deadline.
segments.tr: - FSAポータルにログインし、残高とプランの期限を確認します。

segments.src: - Find out whether your plan uses a carryover, a grace period, or nothing.
segments.tr: - プランが繰り越し、猶予期間、またはそのどちらも採用していないかを確認します。

segments.src: - Look at the claims run-out deadline. Even if you incur an expense on time, you usually must submit the claim by a set date.
segments.tr: - 請求の受付期限を確認します。期限内に費用が発生した場合でも、通常は設定された日までに請求を提出する必要があります。

segments.src: - Spend wisely. Eligible items often include prescription copays, dental work, vision exams and glasses, and many over-the-counter products. Check your plan's eligibility list before buying.
segments.tr: - 賢く使いましょう。対象となる品目には、多くの場合、処方薬の自己負担分、歯科治療、視力検査や眼鏡、および多くの一般用医薬品が含まれます。購入前にプランの対象リストをご確認ください。

segments.src: Dependent care FSAs follow their own rules and often do not allow carryover, so check them separately.
segments.tr: 要介護者ケアFSAには独自のルールがあり、通常は繰り越しが認められていないため、個別に確認してください。

segments.src: ## 2. Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
segments.tr: ## 2. 必須最低分配金（RMDs）

segments.src: If you hold a traditional IRA or most employer retirement plans, the government eventually requires you to start withdrawing money.
segments.tr: 伝統的IRA（個人退職口座）またはほとんどの企業の退職プランを保有している場合、政府は最終的に引き出しを開始することを義務付けています。

segments.src: These withdrawals are called required minimum distributions.
segments.tr: これらの引き出しは必須最低分配金と呼ばれます。

segments.src: Under current federal law, the starting age depends on your birth year.
segments.tr: 現在の連邦法の下では、開始年齢は出生年によって異なります。

segments.src: It is 73 for many people today and rises to 75 for those born in 1960 or later.
segments.tr: 現在多くの人にとって73歳であり、1960年以降に生まれた人については75歳に引き上げられます。

segments.src: Confirm your own age requirement with the IRS or a tax professional.
segments.tr: ご自身の年齢要件をIRSまたは税務専門家にご確認ください。

segments.src: Key points:
segments.tr: 主なポイント：

segments.src: - **The annual deadline is generally December 31.** Your first RMD is the exception: you may delay it until April 1 of the following year. Delaying means you take two distributions in one calendar year, which can push you into a higher tax bracket.
segments.tr: - **年次期限は通常12月31日です。** 初めてのRMDには例外があります。翌年の4月1日まで延期することができます。延期するということは、1つの暦年で2つの分配金を受け取ることを意味し、より高い税率のブラケットに押し上げられる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Missing an RMD carries a penalty.** The excise tax on a missed amount has been reduced in recent years, but it is still significant. The IRS may waive it if you show reasonable cause and correct the shortfall promptly.
segments.tr: - **RMDを怠るとペナルティが発生します。** 見逃した金額に対する物品税は近年引き下げられましたが、依然として無視できない額です。正当な理由を示し、不足分を速やかに修正した場合、IRSはこれを免除する場合があります。

segments.src: - **Calculations are done per account type.** Traditional IRAs can often be aggregated, so you may take the total from one account. Employer plans such as 401(k)s generally must be calculated and withdrawn separately.
segments.tr: - **計算は口座タイプごとに行われます。** 伝統的IRAはしばしば合算できるため、1つの口座から合計額を受け取ることができます。401(k)などの企業プランは、通常、個別に計算して引き出す必要があります。

segments.src: - **Inherited accounts have their own rules.** Many beneficiaries must empty inherited retirement accounts within a set number of years, and some must also take annual distributions. This area is complicated and frequently misunderstood.
segments.tr: - **相続口座には独自のルールがあります。** 多くの受益者は、一定年数以内に相続した退職口座を空にする必要があり、また毎年分配金を受け取らなければならない場合もあります。この分野は複雑で、しばしば誤解されています。

segments.src: Roth IRAs do not require withdrawals during the original owner's lifetime.
segments.tr: Roth IRA（ロスIRA）では、元の所有者の生存中にお金を引き出す必要はありません。

segments.src: **Commonly missed:** People who have several accounts, who recently changed custodians, or who inherited an account sometimes overlook one of them.
segments.tr: **見落とされがちなこと：** 複数の口座を持っている人、最近カストディアンを変更した人、または口座を相続した人は、時々そのうちの1つを見落とすことがあります。

segments.src: Ask each custodian whether an RMD is due and what amount they calculated.
segments.tr: 各カストディアンにRMDの期限が来ているかどうか、および彼らが計算した金額を尋ねてください。

segments.src: ## 3. Charitable Giving
segments.tr: ## 3. 慈善寄付

segments.src: Donations made by December 31 may count toward your 2026 tax year, but the benefit depends on whether you itemize deductions.
segments.tr: 12月31日までに実行された寄付は2026年課税年度の対象となる可能性がありますが、その恩恵は控除を項目別にするかどうかに依存します。

segments.src: Points to consider:
segments.tr: 考慮すべき点：

segments.src: - **Itemizing vs. the standard deduction.** Most households take the standard deduction, which means a cash gift may not reduce taxes unless your total itemized deductions exceed it. Recent law changes have affected how charitable deductions work for different filers, so review the current rules for 2026.
segments.tr: - **項目別控除と標準控除の比較。** ほとんどの世帯は標準控除を利用するため、総項目別控除額がそれを超えない限り、現金の寄付によって税金が減額されない場合があります。最近の法律の変更は、異なる申告者のための慈善控除の仕組みに影響を与えているため、2026年の現在のルールを確認してください。

segments.src: - **Timing counts.** Generally, a gift is dated when you hand it over, for example when a check is mailed or a card charge is processed. Do not wait until the last day, since processing delays can push a gift into the next year.
segments.tr: - **タイミングが重要です。** 一般的に、寄付は小切手が郵送されたりカード決済が処理されたりするなど、手放したときに日付が付けられます。処理の遅延によって寄付が翌年にずれ込む可能性があるため、最終日まで待たないでください。

segments.src: - **Keep records.** Save receipts or written acknowledgments, especially for larger gifts. Confirm that the organization is a qualifying charity.
segments.tr: - **記録を保管してください。** 領収書や書面による受領書、特に多額の寄付の場合は保存しておきましょう。組織が適格な慈善団体であることを確認してください。

segments.src: - **Appreciated assets.** Donating stock or other assets you have held for more than a year can sometimes let you avoid capital gains tax on the appreciation. Transfers take time, so start early.
segments.tr: - **値上がりした資産。** 1年以上保有している株式やその他の資産を寄付すると、値上がりに対するキャピタルゲイン課税を回避できる場合があります。移転には時間がかかるため、早めに始めてください。

segments.src: - **Qualified charitable distributions (QCDs).** If you are old enough (generally 70½ or older), you can send money directly from an IRA to a charity. A QCD can count toward your RMD while keeping the amount out of your taxable income. The money must go directly from the IRA to the charity.
segments.tr: - **適格慈善分配（QCDs）。** 十分な年齢に達している場合（通常70歳半以上）、IRAから慈善団体に直接送金することができます。QCDは、課税所得からその金額を除外しながら、RMDにカウントさせることができます。お金はIRAから慈善団体に直接移動する必要があります。

segments.src: - **Donor-advised funds.** These let you make a gift in one year and recommend grants to charities later, which can help you bunch several years of giving into one tax year.
segments.tr: - **寄付者助言基金（Donor-advised funds）。** これらを利用すると、ある年に寄付を行い、後で慈善団体への助成金を推奨することができ、数年分の寄付を1つの課税年度にまとめるのに役立ちます。

segments.src: ## 4. Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
segments.tr: ## 4. 医療費貯蓄口座（HSAs）

segments.src: HSAs differ from FSAs in one important way: the money generally stays yours and does not expire at year end.
segments.tr: HSAは1つの重要な点でFSAとは異なります。お金は原則としてあなたの所有物であり続け、年末に消滅することはありません。

segments.src: However, some HSA-related deadlines still matter.
segments.tr: ただし、HSAに関連するいくつかの期限は依然として重要です。

segments.src: - **Eligibility.** You can contribute only if you are covered by a qualifying high-deductible health plan and have no disqualifying other coverage.
segments.tr: - **受給資格。** 適格な高額免責金額健康保険に加入しており、資格を失うような他の保険に加入していない場合にのみ、拠出することができます。

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits for self-only and family coverage, with an additional catch-up amount for those 55 and older. Check the 2026 figures before you contribute.
segments.tr: - **拠出限度額。** IRSは単身および家族向け保険の年間限度額を定めており、55歳以上向けの追加のキャッチアップ額もあります。拠出する前に2026年の数値を確認してください。

segments.src: - **Deadline.** Unlike many year-end items, you can usually make contributions for the tax year until the tax filing deadline the following April. Payroll contributions, however, must go through your employer during the year.
segments.tr: - **期限。** 多くの年末のアイテムとは異なり、通常は翌年4月の税金申告期限まで課税年度の拠出を行うことができます。ただし、給与天引きによる拠出は、その年の間に雇用主を通じて行う必要があります。

segments.src: - **Don't overfund.** Contributing above the limit, including employer contributions, can trigger a tax penalty unless corrected.
segments.tr: - **過剰拠出を避ける。** 雇用主からの拠出を含め、限度額を超えて拠出すると、修正されない限り税金ペナルティを引き起こす可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Last-month rule.** In certain cases, being eligible in December can allow a full-year contribution, but it comes with a testing period. Understand the conditions before relying on it.
segments.tr: - **12月ルール。** 場合によっては、12月に資格があることで通年の拠出が認められることがありますが、テスト期間が伴います。それに頼る前に条件を理解してください。

segments.src: ## 5. Other Deadlines Worth a Quick Look
segments.tr: ## 5. ちょっと確認する価値のあるその他の期限

segments.src: - **Open enrollment.** Many employer benefit elections, including FSA and HSA amounts, are set during open enrollment. Mark the deadline for choosing 2027 benefits.
segments.tr: - **オープンエンロールメント（加入受付期間）。** FSAやHSAの金額を含む多くの雇用主の福利厚生の選択は、オープンエンロールメント期間に行われます。2027年の福利厚生を選択するための期限にマークを付けてください。

segments.src: - **Retirement plan contributions.** Contributions to a 401(k) generally have to be made through payroll by December 31, while IRA contributions can usually be made until the filing deadline in April. Check whether you are on track to reach your contribution goal and whether your employer match is fully captured.
segments.tr: - **退職プランへの拠出。** 401(k)への拠出は通常12月31日までに給与天引きで行う必要がありますが、IRAへの拠出は通常4月の申告期限まで行うことができます。拠出目標の達成に向けて順調に進んでいるか、また雇用主のマッチングが完全に獲得されているかを確認してください。

segments.src: - **Tax-loss harvesting.** Investors with taxable accounts sometimes sell losing positions to offset gains. Be aware of the wash-sale rule, which can disallow a loss if you buy back a substantially identical investment too soon.
segments.tr: - **タックス・ロス・ハーベスティング。** 課税口座を持つ投資家は、利益相殺のために損失が出ているポジションを売却することがあります。実質的に同一の投資を早すぎる段階で買い戻した場合に損失が認められなくなる「ウォッシュ・セール・ルール」に注意してください。

segments.src: - **Gift tax annual exclusion.** Gifts to individuals up to the annual limit generally do not require a gift tax return. The exclusion does not carry over to the next year.
segments.tr: - **贈与税の年間非課税枠。** 年間限度額までの個人への贈与は、通常、贈与税申告書を必要としません。この非課税枠は翌年に繰り越されません。

segments.src: - **Estimated taxes.** If you have freelance, business or investment income, review whether you have paid enough during the year to avoid underpayment penalties.
segments.tr: - **予定納税。** フリーランス、事業、または投資による所得がある場合は、過少納付ペナルティを回避するのに十分な金額をその年の間に支払ったかどうかを確認してください。

segments.src: - **Insurance and plan reviews.** Check beneficiary designations, since outdated ones can override what you intend.
segments.tr: - **保険とプランの見直し。** 受取人の指定を確認してください。古いままにしておくと、意図した内容が無効になる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## A Simple Year-End Checklist
segments.tr: ## シンプルな年末チェックリスト

segments.src: 1. **This week:** Check FSA balances and your plan's carryover or grace-period policy.
segments.tr: 1. **今週：** FSAの残高と、プランの繰り越しまたは猶予期間のポリシーを確認します。

segments.src: 2. **By mid-November:** Confirm whether you owe an RMD and contact each custodian.
segments.tr: 2. **1月中旬まで：** RMDの支払い義務があるかどうかを確認し、各カストディアンに連絡します。

segments.src: 3. **By early December:** Decide on charitable gifts and start any stock transfers.
segments.tr: 3. **12月上旬まで：** 慈善寄付を決定し、株式の移転を開始します。

segments.src: 4. **Before December 31:** Make final payroll contribution changes where possible, and complete RMDs and any FSA spending.
segments.tr: 4. **12月31日前：** 可能であれば給与天引きによる拠出の最終変更を行い、RMDおよびFSAの支出を完了させます。

segments.src: 5. **In January:** Gather tax documents and plan your HSA and IRA contributions for the prior year.
segments.tr: 5. **1月中：** 税務書類を集め、前年度のHSAおよびIRAの拠出計画を立てます。

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: Not every deadline applies to everyone.
segments.tr: すべての期限がすべての人に当てはまるわけではありません。

segments.src: The costliest mistakes tend to be the quiet ones: a forgotten FSA balance, a missed RMD on a lesser-used account, or a donation that is processed too late.
segments.tr: 最もコストがかかる間違いは、忘れられたFSAの残高、あまり使われていない口座でのRMDの失念、あるいは処理が遅すぎた寄付など、目立たないものである傾向があります。

segments.src: A short review in the next few weeks can help you avoid unpleasant surprises.
segments.tr: 今後数週間のうちに短く見直すことで、不快なサプライズを避けることができます。

segments.src: When in doubt, check with your plan administrator or a tax professional, since limits and rules change from year to year.
segments.tr: 迷ったときは、限度額やルールが年々変わるため、プラン管理者や税務専門家にご確認ください。

de.title: Nutzen Sie es oder verlieren Sie es: Die Fristen für das Jahresende, die Sie vor dem 31. Dezember prüfen sollten

segments.src: With roughly two months left in 2026, now is a practical time to review a handful of money deadlines that fall on or near December 31.
segments.tr: Da im Jahr 2026 noch etwa zwei Monate verbleiben, ist jetzt ein günstiger Zeitpunkt, um einige Geldfristen zu überprüfen, die auf oder um den 31. Dezember fallen.

segments.src: Some can cost you real money if missed, while others are optional but useful.
segments.tr: Einige können Sie echtes Geld kosten, wenn Sie sie verpassen, während andere optional, aber nützlich sind.

segments.src: This guide covers which ones matter, who they apply to, and which are most often overlooked.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden behandelt, welche davon wichtig sind, für wen sie gelten und welche am häufigsten übersehen werden.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax, legal or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel dient allgemeinen Information und stellt keine steuerliche, rechtliche oder finanzielle Beratung dar.

segments.src: Rules vary by plan and personal situation, so confirm details with your plan administrator, the IRS, or a qualified professional.*
segments.tr: Die Regeln variieren je nach Plan und persönlicher Situation, bestätigen Sie daher Details mit Ihrem Planadministrator, dem IRS oder einem qualifizierten Experten.*

segments.src: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Check Your Plan's Rules
segments.tr: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Prüfen Sie die Regeln Ihres Plans

segments.src: A health care FSA lets you set aside pre-tax money for eligible medical expenses.
segments.tr: Ein Gesundheits-FSA ermöglicht es Ihnen, steuerfreies Geld für berechtigte medizinische Kosten zurückzulegen.

segments.src: The classic drawback is the "use it or lose it" rule: money left unspent at the end of the plan year may be forfeited.
segments.tr: Der klassische Nachteil ist die Regel "Nutzen Sie es oder verlieren Sie es": Geld, das am Ende des Planjahres nicht ausgegeben wurde, kann verfallen.

segments.src: Employers can soften that rule in one of two ways, but they are not required to offer either:
segments.tr: Arbeitgeber können diese Regel auf eine von zwei Arten abmildern, sie sind jedoch nicht verpflichtet, eine davon anzubieten:

segments.src: - **Carryover:** Some plans let you roll over a limited amount into the next year. The IRS adjusts the maximum carryover annually, so check the current figure with your plan.
segments.tr: - **Übertrag (Carryover):** Einige Pläne erlauben es Ihnen, einen begrenzten Betrag in das nächste Jahr zu übertragen. Der IRS passt den maximalen Übertrag jährlich an, prüfen Sie daher den aktuellen Betrag bei Ihrem Plan.

segments.src: - **Grace period:** Some plans give you extra time, up to two and a half months, to incur new expenses against last year's balance.
segments.tr: - **Kulanzfrist (Grace period):** Einige Pläne geben Ihnen zusätzliche Zeit, bis zu zweieinhalb Monate, um neue Ausgaben gegen den Saldo des letzten Jahres zu tätigen.

segments.src: A plan may offer one of these options, but not both.
segments.tr: Ein Plan kann eine dieser Optionen anbieten, aber nicht beide.

segments.src: Many employers offer neither.
segments.tr: Viele Arbeitgeber bieten keine an.

segments.src: **What to do now:**
segments.tr: **Was jetzt zu tun ist:**

segments.src: - Log in to your FSA portal and check your remaining balance and your plan's deadline.
segments.tr: - Melden Sie sich in Ihrem FSA-Portal an und prüfen Sie Ihr verbleibendes Guthaben sowie die Frist Ihres Plans.

segments.src: - Find out whether your plan uses a carryover, a grace period, or nothing.
segments.tr: - Finden Sie heraus, ob Ihr Plan einen Übertrag, eine Kulanzfrist oder keines von beidem verwendet.

segments.src: - Look at the claims run-out deadline. Even if you incur an expense on time, you usually must submit the claim by a set date.
segments.tr: - Betrachten Sie die Einreichungsfrist für Ansprüche. Selbst wenn Sie eine Ausgabe rechtzeitig tätigen, müssen Sie den Anspruch normalerweise bis zu einem bestimmten Datum einreichen.

segments.src: - Spend wisely. Eligible items often include prescription copays, dental work, vision exams and glasses, and many over-the-counter products. Check your plan's eligibility list before buying.
segments.tr: - Geben Sie klug aus. Berechtigte Artikel umfassen oft Rezeptzuzahlungen, zahnärztliche Behandlungen, Sehtests und Brillen sowie viele rezeptfreie Produkte. Prüfen Sie die Berechtigungsliste Ihres Plans vor dem Kauf.

segments.src: Dependent care FSAs follow their own rules and often do not allow carryover, so check them separately.
segments.tr: FSAs für die Pflege von Angehörigen folgen eigenen Regeln und erlauben oft keinen Übertrag, prüfen Sie diese daher separat.

segments.src: ## 2. Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
segments.tr: ## 2. Erforderliche Mindestausschüttungen (Required Minimum Distributions - RMDs)

segments.src: If you hold a traditional IRA or most employer retirement plans, the government eventually requires you to start withdrawing money.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie ein traditionelles IRA oder die meisten Altersvorsorgepläne von Arbeitgebern halten, verlangt die Regierung schließlich, dass Sie mit der Auszahlung von Geld beginnen.

segments.src: These withdrawals are called required minimum distributions.
segments.tr: Diese Auszahlungen werden als erforderliche Mindestausschüttungen bezeichnet.

segments.src: Under current federal law, the starting age depends on your birth year.
segments.tr: Nach geltendem Bundesrecht hängt das Startalter von Ihrem Geburtsjahr ab.

segments.src: It is 73 for many people today and rises to 75 for those born in 1960 or later.
segments.tr: Es liegt heute für viele Menschen bei 73 und steigt auf 75 für diejenigen, die 1960 oder später geboren wurden.

segments.src: Confirm your own age requirement with the IRS or a tax professional.
segments.tr: Bestätigen Sie Ihre eigene Altersanforderung beim IRS oder einem Steuerberater.

segments.src: Key points:
segments.tr: Kernpunkte:

segments.src: - **The annual deadline is generally December 31.** Your first RMD is the exception: you may delay it until April 1 of the following year. Delaying means you take two distributions in one calendar year, which can push you into a higher tax bracket.
segments.tr: - **Die jährliche Frist ist im Allgemeinen der 31. Dezember.** Ihre erste RMD ist die Ausnahme: Sie können sie bis zum 1. April des folgenden Jahres aufschieben. Das Aufschieben bedeutet, dass Sie zwei Ausschüttungen in einem Kalenderjahr vornehmen, was Sie in eine höhere Steuerklasse bringen kann.

segments.src: - **Missing an RMD carries a penalty.** The excise tax on a missed amount has been reduced in recent years, but it is still significant. The IRS may waive it if you show reasonable cause and correct the shortfall promptly.
segments.tr: - **Das Verpassen einer RMD ist mit einer Strafe verbunden.** Die Verbrauchsteuer auf einen verpassten Betrag wurde in den letzten Jahren gesenkt, ist aber immer noch erheblich. Der IRS kann darauf verzichten, wenn Sie einen triftigen Grund nachweisen und den Fehlbetrag umgehend korrigieren.

segments.src: - **Calculations are done per account type.** Traditional IRAs can often be aggregated, so you may take the total from one account. Employer plans such as 401(k)s generally must be calculated and withdrawn separately.
segments.tr: - **Berechnungen erfolgen pro Kontotyp.** Traditionelle IRAs können oft zusammengelegt werden, sodass Sie die Gesamtsumme von einem Konto nehmen können. Arbeitgeberpläne wie 401(k)s müssen im Allgemeinen separat berechnet und ausgezahlt werden.

segments.src: - **Inherited accounts have their own rules.** Many beneficiaries must empty inherited retirement accounts within a set number of years, and some must also take annual distributions. This area is complicated and frequently misunderstood.
segments.tr: - **Vererbte Konten haben ihre eigenen Regeln.** Viele Begünstigte müssen geerbte Altersvorsorgekonten innerhalb einer festgelegten Anzahl von Jahren auflösen, und einige müssen auch jährliche Ausschüttungen vornehmen. Dieser Bereich ist kompliziert und wird häufig missverstanden.

segments.src: Roth IRAs do not require withdrawals during the original owner's lifetime.
segments.tr: Roth IRAs erfordern keine Auszahlungen zu Lebzeiten des ursprünglichen Eigentümers.

segments.src: **Commonly missed:** People who have several accounts, who recently changed custodians, or who inherited an account sometimes overlook one of them.
segments.tr: **Häufig übersehen:** Personen, die mehrere Konten haben, kürzlich den Verwahrer gewechselt haben oder ein Konto geerbt haben, übersehen manchmal eines davon.

segments.src: Ask each custodian whether an RMD is due and what amount they calculated.
segments.tr: Fragen Sie jeden Verwahrer, ob eine RMD fällig ist und welchen Betrag er berechnet hat.

segments.src: ## 3. Charitable Giving
segments.tr: ## 3. Wohltätige Spenden (Charitable Giving)

segments.src: Donations made by December 31 may count toward your 2026 tax year, but the benefit depends on whether you itemize deductions.
segments.tr: Spenden, die bis zum 31. Dezember getätigt werden, können auf Ihr Steuerjahr 2026 angerechnet werden, aber der Vorteil hängt davon ab, ob Sie Abzüge detailliert aufführen.

segments.src: Points to consider:
segments.tr: Zu berücksichtigende Punkte:

segments.src: - **Itemizing vs. the standard deduction.** Most households take the standard deduction, which means a cash gift may not reduce taxes unless your total itemized deductions exceed it. Recent law changes have affected how charitable deductions work for different filers, so review the current rules for 2026.
segments.tr: - **Detaillierte Aufführung vs. Standardabzug.** Die meisten Haushalte nehmen den Standardabzug, was bedeutet, dass eine Geldspende die Steuern möglicherweise nicht senkt, es sei denn, Ihre gesamten detaillierten Abzüge übersteigen diesen. Jüngste Gesetzesänderungen haben beeinflusst, wie Spendenabzüge für verschiedene Steuerzahler funktionieren, überprüfen Sie daher die aktuellen Regeln für 2026.

segments.src: - **Timing counts.** Generally, a gift is dated when you hand it over, for example when a check is mailed or a card charge is processed. Do not wait until the last day, since processing delays can push a gift into the next year.
segments.tr: - **Der Zeitpunkt zählt.** Im Allgemeinen wird eine Spende datiert, wenn Sie sie übergeben, zum Beispiel wenn ein Scheck verschickt oder eine Kartenbelastung verarbeitet wird. Warten Sie nicht bis zum letzten Tag, da Bearbeitungsverzögerungen eine Spende in das nächste Jahr verschieben können.

segments.src: - **Keep records.** Save receipts or written acknowledgments, especially for larger gifts. Confirm that the organization is a qualifying charity.
segments.tr: - **Aufzeichnungen führen.** Bewahren Sie Quittungen oder schriftliche Bestätigungen auf, insbesondere bei größeren Spenden. Bestätigen Sie, dass die Organisation eine berechtigte Wohltätigkeitsorganisation ist.

segments.src: - **Appreciated assets.** Donating stock or other assets you have held for more than a year can sometimes let you avoid capital gains tax on the appreciation. Transfers take time, so start early.
segments.tr: - **Wertgesteigerte Vermögenswerte.** Das Spenden von Aktien oder anderen Vermögenswerten, die Sie länger als ein Jahr gehalten haben, kann es Ihnen manchmal ermöglichen, Kapitalertragsteuer auf die Wertsteigerung zu vermeiden. Übertragungen dauern ihre Zeit, fangen Sie also früh an.

segments.src: - **Qualified charitable distributions (QCDs).** If you are old enough (generally 70½ or older), you can send money directly from an IRA to a charity. A QCD can count toward your RMD while keeping the amount out of your taxable income. The money must go directly from the IRA to the charity.
segments.tr: - **Qualifizierte Spenden (Qualified charitable distributions - QCDs).** Wenn Sie alt genug sind (im Allgemeinen 70½ oder älter), können Sie Geld direkt von einem IRA an eine Wohltätigkeitsorganisation senden. Eine QCD kann auf Ihre RMD angerechnet werden und gleichzeitig den Betrag aus Ihrem steuerpflichtigen Einkommen heraushalten. Das Geld muss direkt vom IRA an die Wohltätigkeitsorganisation gehen.

segments.src: - **Donor-advised funds.** These let you make a gift in one year and recommend grants to charities later, which can help you bunch several years of giving into one tax year.
segments.tr: - **Spenderempfohlene Fonds (Donor-advised funds).** Diese ermöglichen es Ihnen, in einem Jahr eine Spende zu tätigen und später Zuschüsse an Wohltätigkeitsorganisationen zu empfehlen, was Ihnen helfen kann, mehrere Jahre des Spens in einem Steuerjahr zu bündeln.

segments.src: ## 4. Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
segments.tr: ## 4. Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)

segments.src: HSAs differ from FSAs in one important way: the money generally stays yours and does not expire at year end.
segments.tr: HSAs unterscheiden sich in einem wichtigen Punkt von FSAs: Das Geld bleibt im Allgemeinen Ihr Eigentum und verfällt nicht zum Jahresende.

segments.src: However, some HSA-related deadlines still matter.
segments.tr: Dennoch sind einige HSA-bezogene Fristen wichtig.

segments.src: - **Eligibility.** You can contribute only if you are covered by a qualifying high-deductible health plan and have no disqualifying other coverage.
segments.tr: - **Berechtigung.** Sie können nur dann einzahlen, wenn Sie durch einen qualifizierenden Krankenversicherungsplan mit hoher Selbstbeteiligung abgesichert sind und keine andere ausschließende Absicherung haben.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits for self-only and family coverage, with an additional catch-up amount for those 55 and older. Check the 2026 figures before you contribute.
segments.tr: - **Beitragsgrenzen.** Der IRS legt jährliche Grenzen für Einzel- und Familienabsicherung fest, mit einem zusätzlichen Nachholbetrag für Personen ab 55 Jahren. Prüfen Sie die Zahlen für 2026, bevor Sie einzahlen.

segments.src: - **Deadline.** Unlike many year-end items, you can usually make contributions for the tax year until the tax filing deadline the following April. Payroll contributions, however, must go through your employer during the year.
segments.tr: - **Frist.** Im Gegensatz zu vielen jahresendbezogenen Posten können Sie Beiträge für das Steuerjahr normalerweise bis zur Steuererklärungsfrist im folgenden April leisten. Lohnabzüge müssen jedoch während des Jahres über Ihren Arbeitgeber erfolgen.

segments.src: - **Don't overfund.** Contributing above the limit, including employer contributions, can trigger a tax penalty unless corrected.
segments.tr: - **Nicht überziehen.** Das Einzahlen über das Limit hinaus, einschließlich Arbeitgeberbeiträgen, kann eine Steuerstrafe auslösen, es sei denn, es wird korrigiert.

segments.src: - **Last-month rule.** In certain cases, being eligible in December can allow a full-year contribution, but it comes with a testing period. Understand the conditions before relying on it.
segments.tr: - **Regel für den letzten Monat.** In bestimmten Fällen kann die Berechtigung im Dezember einen Ganzjahresbeitrag ermöglichen, aber dies geht mit einer Testphase einher. Verstehen Sie die Bedingungen, bevor Sie sich darauf verlassen.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Deadlines Worth a Quick Look
segments.tr: ## 5. Andere Fristen, die einen kurzen Blick wert sind

segments.src: - **Open enrollment.** Many employer benefit elections, including FSA and HSA amounts, are set during open enrollment. Mark the deadline for choosing 2027 benefits.
segments.tr: - **Offene Einschreibung (Open enrollment).** Viele Leistungsentscheidungen des Arbeitgebers, einschließlich FSA- und HSA-Beträge, werden während der offenen Einschreibung festgelegt. Markieren Sie die Frist für die Auswahl der Leistungen für 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement plan contributions.** Contributions to a 401(k) generally have to be made through payroll by December 31, while IRA contributions can usually be made until the filing deadline in April. Check whether you are on track to reach your contribution goal and whether your employer match is fully captured.
segments.tr: - **Beiträge zur Altersvorsorge.** Beiträge zu einem 401(k) müssen im Allgemeinen bis zum 31. Dezember über die Lohnabrechnung geleistet werden, während IRA-Beiträge normalerweise bis zur Einreichungsfrist im April geleistet werden können. Prüfen Sie, ob Sie auf dem richtigen Weg sind, Ihr Beitragsziel zu erreichen, und ob Ihr Arbeitgeberzuschuss vollständig ausgeschöpft wird.

segments.src: - **Tax-loss harvesting.** Investors with taxable accounts sometimes sell losing positions to offset gains. Be aware of the wash-sale rule, which can disallow a loss if you buy back a substantially identical investment too soon.
segments.tr: - **Steuerverlust-Ernte (Tax-loss harvesting).** Investoren mit steuerpflichtigen Konten verkaufen manchmal verlustbringende Positionen, um Gewinne auszugleichen. Achten Sie auf die Was-Sale-Regel, die einen Verlust ungültig machen kann, wenn Sie eine im Wesentlichen identische Investition zu früh zurückkaufen.

segments.src: - **Gift tax annual exclusion.** Gifts to individuals up to the annual limit generally do not require a gift tax return. The exclusion does not carry over to the next year.
segments.tr: - **Jährlicher Ausschluss der Schenkungssteuer.** Geschenke an Einzelpersonen bis zum jährlichen Limit erfordern im Allgemeinen keine Schenkungsteuererklärung. Der Ausschluss wird nicht in das nächste Jahr übertragen.

segments.src: - **Estimated taxes.** If you have freelance, business or investment income, review whether you have paid enough during the year to avoid underpayment penalties.
segments.tr: - **Geschätzte Steuern.** Wenn Sie freiberufliche, geschäftliche oder Einkünfte aus Kapitalvermögen haben, überprüfen Sie, ob Sie im Laufe des Jahres genug gezahlt haben, um Unterzahlungsstrafen zu vermeiden.

segments.src: - **Insurance and plan reviews.** Check beneficiary designations, since outdated ones can override what you intend.
segments.tr: - **Versicherungs- und Planüberprüfungen.** Überprüfen Sie die Benennung von Begünstigten, da veraltete Ihre Absichten außer Kraft setzen können.

segments.src: ## A Simple Year-End Checklist
segments.tr: ## Eine einfache Jahresend-Checkliste

segments.src: 1. **This week:** Check FSA balances and your plan's carryover or grace-period policy.
segments.tr: 1. **Diese Woche:** Überprüfen Sie die FSA-Guthaben und die Richtlinie Ihres Plans zum Übertrag oder zur Kulanzfrist.

segments.src: 2. **By mid-November:** Confirm whether you owe an RMD and contact each custodian.
segments.tr: 2. **Bis Mitte November:** Bestätigen Sie, ob Sie eine RMD schulden, und kontaktieren Sie jeden Verwahrer.

segments.src: 3. **By early December:** Decide on charitable gifts and start any stock transfers.
segments.tr: 3. **Bis Anfang Dezember:** Entscheiden Sie über Spenden und beginnen Sie mit Aktienübertragungen.

segments.src: 4. **Before December 31:** Make final payroll contribution changes where possible, and complete RMDs and any FSA spending.
segments.tr: 4. **Vor dem 31. Dezember:** Nehmen Sie nach Möglichkeit letzte Änderungen an Lohnbeiträgen vor und schließen Sie RMDs sowie alle FSA-Ausgaben ab.

segments.src: 5. **In January:** Gather tax documents and plan your HSA and IRA contributions for the prior year.
segments.tr: 5. **Im Januar:** Sammeln Sie Steuerdokumente und planen Sie Ihre HSA- und IRA-Beiträge für das Vorjahr.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: Not every deadline applies to everyone.
segments.tr: Nicht jede Frist gilt für jeden.

segments.src: The costliest mistakes tend to be the quiet ones: a forgotten FSA balance, a missed RMD on a lesser-used account, or a donation that is processed too late.
segments.tr: Die kostspieligsten Fehler sind tendenziell die unauffälligen: ein vergessenes FSA-Guthaben, eine verpasste RMD auf einem weniger genutzten Konto oder eine Spende, die zu spät bearbeitet wird.

segments.src: A short review in the next few weeks can help you avoid unpleasant surprises.
segments.tr: Eine kurze Überprüfung in den nächsten Wochen kann Ihnen helfen, unangenehme Überraschungen zu vermeiden.

segments.src: When in doubt, check with your plan administrator or a tax professional, since limits and rules change from year to year.
segments.tr: Wenden Sie sich im Zweifelsfall an Ihren Planadministrator oder einen Steuerberater, da sich Limits und Regeln von Jahr zu Jahr ändern.

vi.title: Dùng hoặc Mất: Các Hạn Chót Tài Chính Cuối Năm Cần Kiểm Tra Trước Ngày 31 Tháng 12

segments.src: With roughly two months left in 2026, now is a practical time to review a handful of money deadlines that fall on or near December 31.
segments.tr: Với khoảng hai tháng còn lại trong năm 2026, đây là thời điểm thiết thực để xem xét một số hạn chót về tiền bạc rơi vào hoặc gần ngày 31 tháng 12.

segments.src: Some can cost you real money if missed, while others are optional but useful.
segments.tr: Một số hạn chót có thể khiến bạn mất tiền thật nếu bỏ lỡ, trong khi những hạn chót khác mang tính tùy chọn nhưng hữu ích.

segments.src: This guide covers which ones matter, who they apply to, and which are most often overlooked.
segments.tr: Hướng dẫn này đề cập đến những hạn chót nào quan trọng, chúng áp dụng cho ai và khoản nào thường bị bỏ qua nhất.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax, legal or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Bài viết này mang tính thông tin chung, không phải là lời khuyên về thuế, pháp lý hay tài chính.

segments.src: Rules vary by plan and personal situation, so confirm details with your plan administrator, the IRS, or a qualified professional.*
segments.tr: Các quy định khác nhau tùy theo kế hoạch và hoàn cảnh cá nhân, vì vậy hãy xác nhận chi tiết với quản trị viên kế hoạch của bạn, IRS hoặc một chuyên gia có trình độ.*

segments.src: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Check Your Plan's Rules
segments.tr: ## 1. Tài khoản Chi tiêu Kế hoạch (FSA): Kiểm tra Quy định của Kế hoạch Bạn

segments.src: A health care FSA lets you set aside pre-tax money for eligible medical expenses.
segments.tr: FSA chăm sóc sức khỏe cho phép bạn dành ra khoản tiền trước thuế cho các chi phí y tế đủ điều kiện.

segments.src: The classic drawback is the "use it or lose it" rule: money left unspent at the end of the plan year may be forfeited.
segments.tr: Nhược điểm kinh điển là quy tắc "dùng hoặc mất": số tiền chưa chi tiêu vào cuối năm kế hoạch có thể bị tịch thu.

segments.src: Employers can soften that rule in one of two ways, but they are not required to offer either:
segments.tr: Người sử dụng lao động có thể nới lỏng quy tắc đó theo một trong hai cách, nhưng họ không bắt buộc phải cung cấp:

segments.src: - **Carryover:** Some plans let you roll over a limited amount into the next year. The IRS adjusts the maximum carryover annually, so check the current figure with your plan.
segments.tr: - **Chuyển số dư:** Một số kế hoạch cho phép bạn chuyển một số tiền hạn chế sang năm sau. IRS điều chỉnh mức chuyển tối đa hàng năm, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra số liệu hiện tại với kế hoạch của bạn.

segments.src: - **Grace period:** Some plans give you extra time, up to two and a half months, to incur new expenses against last year's balance.
segments.tr: - **Thời gian ân hạn:** Một số kế hoạch cho bạn thêm thời gian, lên đến hai tháng rưỡi, để phát sinh các chi phí mới dựa trên số dư của năm ngoái.

segments.src: A plan may offer one of these options, but not both.
segments.tr: Một kế hoạch có thể cung cấp một trong những tùy chọn này, nhưng không phải cả hai.

segments.src: Many employers offer neither.
segments.tr: Nhiều chủ lao động không cung cấp tùy chọn nào.

segments.src: **What to do now:**
segments.tr: **Việc cần làm ngay bây giờ:**

segments.src: - Log in to your FSA portal and check your remaining balance and your plan's deadline.
segments.tr: - Đăng nhập vào cổng thông tin FSA của bạn và kiểm tra số dư còn lại cũng như hạn chót của kế hoạch.

segments.src: - Find out whether your plan uses a carryover, a grace period, or nothing.
segments.tr: - Tìm hiểu xem kế hoạch của bạn sử dụng tính năng chuyển số dư, thời gian ân hạn hay không có gì.

segments.src: - Look at the claims run-out deadline. Even if you incur an expense on time, you usually must submit the claim by a set date.
segments.tr: - Xem xét hạn chót nộp yêu cầu bồi thường. Ngay cả khi bạn phát sinh chi phí đúng hạn, bạn thường phải nộp yêu cầu trước một ngày cố định.

segments.src: - Spend wisely. Eligible items often include prescription copays, dental work, vision exams and glasses, and many over-the-counter products. Check your plan's eligibility list before buying.
segments.tr: - Chi tiêu khôn ngoan. Các mặt hàng đủ điều kiện thường bao gồm tiền đồng chi trả đơn thuốc, nha khoa, khám mắt và kính, cùng nhiều sản phẩm không cần kê đơn. Kiểm tra danh sách đủ điều kiện của kế hoạch trước khi mua.

segments.src: Dependent care FSAs follow their own rules and often do not allow carryover, so check them separately.
segments.tr: FSA chăm sóc người phụ thuộc tuân theo các quy tắc riêng và thường không cho phép chuyển số dư, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra chúng một cách riêng biệt.

segments.src: ## 2. Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
segments.tr: ## 2. Phân phối Tối thiểu Bắt buộc (RMD)

segments.src: If you hold a traditional IRA or most employer retirement plans, the government eventually requires you to start withdrawing money.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn sở hữu một tài khoản IRA truyền thống hoặc hầu hết các kế hoạch hưu trí của người sử dụng lao động, chính phủ cuối cùng sẽ yêu cầu bạn bắt đầu rút tiền.

segments.src: These withdrawals are called required minimum distributions.
segments.tr: Những khoản rút tiền này được gọi là phân phối tối thiểu bắt buộc.

segments.src: Under current federal law, the starting age depends on your birth year.
segments.tr: Theo luật liên bang hiện hành, độ tuổi bắt đầu tùy thuộc vào năm sinh của bạn.

segments.src: It is 73 for many people today and rises to 75 for those born in 1960 or later.
segments.tr: Đó là 73 tuổi đối với nhiều người hiện nay và tăng lên 75 đối với những người sinh năm 1960 trở về sau.

segments.src: Confirm your own age requirement with the IRS or a tax professional.
segments.tr: Xác nhận yêu cầu độ tuổi của riêng bạn với IRS hoặc chuyên gia thuế.

segments.src: Key points:
segments.tr: Các điểm chính:

segments.src: - **The annual deadline is generally December 31.** Your first RMD is the exception: you may delay it until April 1 of the following year. Delaying means you take two distributions in one calendar year, which can push you into a higher tax bracket.
segments.tr: - **Hạn chót hàng năm thường là ngày 31 tháng 12.** RMD đầu tiên của bạn là ngoại lệ: bạn có thể hoãn lại cho đến ngày 1 tháng 4 của năm tiếp theo. Hoãn lại có nghĩa là bạn nhận hai khoản phân phối trong một năm dương lịch, điều này có thể đẩy bạn vào khung thuế cao hơn.

segments.src: - **Missing an RMD carries a penalty.** The excise tax on a missed amount has been reduced in recent years, but it is still significant. The IRS may waive it if you show reasonable cause and correct the shortfall promptly.
segments.tr: - **Bỏ lỡ RMD sẽ bị phạt.** Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt đối với số tiền bị bỏ lỡ đã giảm trong những năm gần đây, nhưng nó vẫn đáng kể. IRS có thể miễn thuế nếu bạn đưa ra lý do chính đáng và khắc phục khoản thiếu hụt kịp thời.

segments.src: - **Calculations are done per account type.** Traditional IRAs can often be aggregated, so you may take the total from one account. Employer plans such as 401(k)s generally must be calculated and withdrawn separately.
segments.tr: - **Việc tính toán được thực hiện theo từng loại tài khoản.** Các tài khoản IRA truyền thống thường có thể được gộp lại, vì vậy bạn có thể lấy tổng số từ một tài khoản. Các kế hoạch của người sử dụng lao động như 401(k) thường phải được tính toán và rút riêng.

segments.src: - **Inherited accounts have their own rules.** Many beneficiaries must empty inherited retirement accounts within a set number of years, and some must also take annual distributions. This area is complicated and frequently misunderstood.
segments.tr: - **Tài khoản được thừa kế có quy tắc riêng.** Nhiều người thụ hưởng phải rút hết tiền trong tài khoản hưu trí được thừa kế trong một số năm nhất định, và một số người cũng phải thực hiện phân phối hàng năm. Lĩnh vực này phức tạp và thường bị hiểu lầm.

segments.src: Roth IRAs do not require withdrawals during the original owner's lifetime.
segments.tr: Tài khoản Roth IRA không yêu cầu rút tiền trong suốt cuộc đời của chủ sở hữu ban đầu.

segments.src: **Commonly missed:** People who have several accounts, who recently changed custodians, or who inherited an account sometimes overlook one of them.
segments.tr: **Thường bị bỏ lỡ:** Những người có vài tài khoản, mới thay đổi người giám hộ hoặc thừa kế tài khoản đôi khi bỏ sót một trong số đó.

segments.src: Ask each custodian whether an RMD is due and what amount they calculated.
segments.tr: Hãy hỏi từng người giám hộ xem RMD đến hạn chưa và số tiền họ tính toán là bao nhiêu.

segments.src: ## 3. Charitable Giving
segments.tr: ## 3. Hoạt động Từ thiện

segments.src: Donations made by December 31 may count toward your 2026 tax year, but the benefit depends on whether you itemize deductions.
segments.tr: Các khoản đóng góp thực hiện trước ngày 31 tháng 12 có thể được tính vào năm thuế 2026 của bạn, nhưng lợi ích phụ thuộc vào việc bạn có kê khai các khoản khấu trừ hay không.

segments.src: Points to consider:
segments.tr: Các điểm cần xem xét:

segments.src: - **Itemizing vs. the standard deduction.** Most households take the standard deduction, which means a cash gift may not reduce taxes unless your total itemized deductions exceed it. Recent law changes have affected how charitable deductions work for different filers, so review the current rules for 2026.
segments.tr: - **Kê khai chi tiết so với khấu trừ tiêu chuẩn.** Hầu hết các hộ gia đình chọn khoản khấu trừ tiêu chuẩn, điều đó có nghĩa là một món quà bằng tiền mặt có thể không làm giảm thuế trừ khi tổng các khoản khấu trừ chi tiết vượt quá mức đó. Những thay đổi gần đây về luật đã ảnh hưởng đến cách thức hoạt động của các khoản khấu trừ từ thiện đối với những người nộp thuế khác nhau, vì vậy hãy xem xét các quy định hiện hành cho năm 2026.

segments.src: - **Timing counts.** Generally, a gift is dated when you hand it over, for example when a check is mailed or a card charge is processed. Do not wait until the last day, since processing delays can push a gift into the next year.
segments.tr: - **Thời điểm rất quan trọng.** Nhìn chung, một món quà được ghi ngày khi bạn trao nó đi, ví dụ như khi séc được gửi qua thư hoặc giao dịch thẻ được xử lý. Đừng đợi đến ngày cuối cùng, vì sự chậm trễ trong xử lý có thể đẩy món quà sang năm sau.

segments.src: - **Keep records.** Save receipts or written acknowledgments, especially for larger gifts. Confirm that the organization is a qualifying charity.
segments.tr: - **Lưu giữ hồ sơ.** Lưu biên lai hoặc giấy xác nhận bằng văn bản, đặc biệt đối với các món quà lớn. Xác nhận rằng tổ chức đó là một từ thiện đủ điều kiện.

segments.src: - **Appreciated assets.** Donating stock or other assets you have held for more than a year can sometimes let you avoid capital gains tax on the appreciation. Transfers take time, so start early.
segments.tr: - **Tài sản có giá trị tăng thêm.** Tặng cổ phiếu hoặc tài sản khác mà bạn đã nắm giữ hơn một năm đôi khi có thể giúp bạn tránh thuế lãi vốn đối với phần tăng giá. Việc chuyển nhượng mất thời gian, vì vậy hãy bắt đầu sớm.

segments.src: - **Qualified charitable distributions (QCDs).** If you are old enough (generally 70½ or older), you can send money directly from an IRA to a charity. A QCD can count toward your RMD while keeping the amount out of your taxable income. The money must go directly from the IRA to the charity.
segments.tr: - **Khoản phân phối từ thiện đủ điều kiện (QCD).** Nếu bạn đủ lớn tuổi (thường là 70½ tuổi trở lên), bạn có thể gửi tiền trực tiếp từ tài khoản IRA đến một tổ chức từ thiện. QCD có thể được tính vào RMD của bạn đồng thời giữ cho số tiền đó không nằm trong thu nhập chịu thuế của bạn. Tiền phải đi thẳng từ IRA đến tổ chức từ thiện.

segments.src: - **Donor-advised funds.** These let you make a gift in one year and recommend grants to charities later, which can help you bunch several years of giving into one tax year.
segments.tr: - **Quỹ do nhà tài trợ tư vấn.** Những quỹ này cho phép bạn tặng quà trong một năm và đề xuất các khoản tài trợ cho các tổ chức từ thiện sau đó, giúp bạn gộp nhiều năm tặng quà vào một năm thuế.

segments.src: ## 4. Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
segments.tr: ## 4. Tài khoản Tiết kiệm Y tế (HSA)

segments.src: HSAs differ from FSAs in one important way: the money generally stays yours and does not expire at year end.
segments.tr: HSA khác với FSA ở một điểm quan trọng: tiền thường vẫn là của bạn và không hết hạn vào cuối năm.

segments.src: However, some HSA-related deadlines still matter.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, một số hạn chót liên quan đến HSA vẫn rất quan trọng.

segments.src: - **Eligibility.** You can contribute only if you are covered by a qualifying high-deductible health plan and have no disqualifying other coverage.
segments.tr: - **Tính đủ điều kiện.** Bạn chỉ có thể đóng góp nếu bạn được bảo hiểm bởi một chương trình y tế có mức khấu trừ cao đủ điều kiện và không có phạm vi bảo hiểm nào khác loại trừ.

segments.src: - **Contribution limits.** The IRS sets annual limits for self-only and family coverage, with an additional catch-up amount for those 55 and older. Check the 2026 figures before you contribute.
segments.tr: - **Giới hạn đóng góp.** IRS đặt ra các giới hạn hàng năm cho bảo hiểm tự đóng và gia đình, với một khoản bù đắp bổ sung cho những người từ 55 tuổi trở lên. Kiểm tra các số liệu năm 2026 trước khi bạn đóng góp.

segments.src: - **Deadline.** Unlike many year-end items, you can usually make contributions for the tax year until the tax filing deadline the following April. Payroll contributions, however, must go through your employer during the year.
segments.tr: - **Hạn chót.** Không giống như nhiều khoản cuối năm, bạn thường có thể đóng góp cho năm thuế cho đến hạn chót nộp thuế vào tháng 4 năm sau. Tuy nhiên, các khoản đóng góp qua bảng lương phải thông qua chủ lao động của bạn trong năm.

segments.src: - **Don't overfund.** Contributing above the limit, including employer contributions, can trigger a tax penalty unless corrected.
segments.tr: - **Đừng đóng góp quá mức.** Đóng góp vượt quá giới hạn, bao gồm cả các khoản đóng góp của chủ lao động, có thể kích hoạt hình phạt thuế trừ khi được khắc phục.

segments.src: - **Last-month rule.** In certain cases, being eligible in December can allow a full-year contribution, but it comes with a testing period. Understand the conditions before relying on it.
segments.tr: - **Quy tắc tháng cuối cùng.** Trong một số trường hợp nhất định, việc đủ điều kiện vào tháng 12 có thể cho phép đóng góp cả năm, nhưng nó đi kèm với một thời gian thử nghiệm. Hiểu rõ các điều kiện trước khi dựa vào nó.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Deadlines Worth a Quick Look
segments.tr: ## 5. Các Hạn Chót Khác Đáng Xem Xét Nhanh

segments.src: - **Open enrollment.** Many employer benefit elections, including FSA and HSA amounts, are set during open enrollment. Mark the deadline for choosing 2027 benefits.
segments.tr: - **Mở đăng ký.** Nhiều lựa chọn phúc lợi của chủ lao động, bao gồm số tiền FSA và HSA, được thiết lập trong thời gian mở đăng ký. Đánh dấu hạn chót để chọn phúc lợi năm 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement plan contributions.** Contributions to a 401(k) generally have to be made through payroll by December 31, while IRA contributions can usually be made until the filing deadline in April. Check whether you are on track to reach your contribution goal and whether your employer match is fully captured.
segments.tr: - **Đóng góp kế hoạch hưu trí.** Các khoản đóng góp vào 401(k) thường phải được thực hiện thông qua bảng lương trước ngày 31 tháng 12, trong khi các khoản đóng góp IRA thường có thể được thực hiện cho đến hạn chót nộp đơn vào tháng 4. Kiểm tra xem bạn có đang đi đúng hướng để đạt được mục tiêu đóng góp của mình hay không và khoản đóng góp tương ứng của chủ lao động đã được nhận đầy đủ chưa.

segments.src: - **Tax-loss harvesting.** Investors with taxable accounts sometimes sell losing positions to offset gains. Be aware of the wash-sale rule, which can disallow a loss if you buy back a substantially identical investment too soon.
segments.tr: - **Thu hoạch lỗ thuế.** Các nhà đầu tư có tài khoản chịu thuế đôi khi bán các vị thế thua lỗ để bù đắp lợi nhuận. Hãy lưu ý quy tắc bán wash-sale, có thể từ chối khoản lỗ nếu bạn mua lại một khoản đầu tư tương tự đáng kể quá sớm.

segments.src: - **Gift tax annual exclusion.** Gifts to individuals up to the annual limit generally do not require a gift tax return. The exclusion does not carry over to the next year.
segments.tr: - **Loại trừ hàng năm thuế quà tặng.** Quà tặng cho cá nhân lên đến giới hạn hàng năm thường không yêu cầu tờ khai thuế quà tặng. Khoản loại trừ này không chuyển sang năm sau.

segments.src: - **Estimated taxes.** If you have freelance, business or investment income, review whether you have paid enough during the year to avoid underpayment penalties.
segments.tr: - **Thuế ước tính.** Nếu bạn có thu nhập tự do, kinh doanh hoặc đầu tư, hãy xem xét xem bạn đã trả đủ trong năm để tránh bị phạt nộp thiếu chưa.

segments.src: - **Insurance and plan reviews.** Check beneficiary designations, since outdated ones can override what you intend.
segments.tr: - **Đánh giá bảo hiểm và kế hoạch.** Kiểm tra việc chỉ định người thụ hưởng, vì những chỉ định lỗi thời có thể ghi đè lên những gì bạn dự định.

segments.src: ## A Simple Year-End Checklist
segments.tr: ## Danh Sách Kiểm Tra Cuối Năm Đơn Giản

segments.src: 1. **This week:** Check FSA balances and your plan's carryover or grace-period policy.
segments.tr: 1. **Tuần này:** Kiểm tra số dư FSA và chính sách chuyển số dư hoặc thời gian ân hạn của kế hoạch bạn.

segments.src: 2. **By mid-November:** Confirm whether you owe an RMD and contact each custodian.
segments.tr: 2. **Đến giữa tháng 11:** Xác nhận xem bạn có nợ RMD hay không và liên hệ với từng người giám hộ.

segments.src: 3. **By early December:** Decide on charitable gifts and start any stock transfers.
segments.tr: 3. **Đến đầu tháng 12:** Quyết định về quà tặng từ thiện và bắt đầu bất kỳ việc chuyển nhượng cổ phiếu nào.

segments.src: 4. **Before December 31:** Make final payroll contribution changes where possible, and complete RMDs and any FSA spending.
segments.tr: 4. **Trước ngày 31 tháng 12:** Thực hiện các thay đổi đóng góp bảng lương cuối cùng nếu có thể, và hoàn thành RMD cũng như mọi khoản chi tiêu FSA.

segments.src: 5. **In January:** Gather tax documents and plan your HSA and IRA contributions for the prior year.
segments.tr: 5. **Vào tháng 1:** Thu thập các tài liệu thuế và lên kế hoạch đóng góp HSA và IRA của bạn cho năm trước.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm Mấu Chốt

segments.src: Not every deadline applies to everyone.
segments.tr: Không phải mọi hạn chót đều áp dụng cho tất cả mọi người.

segments.src: The costliest mistakes tend to be the quiet ones: a forgotten FSA balance, a missed RMD on a lesser-used account, or a donation that is processed too late.
segments.tr: Những sai lầm tốn kém nhất thường là những sai lầm âm thầm: số dư FSA bị quên, RMD bị bỏ lỡ trên tài khoản ít sử dụng hơn, hoặc khoản quyên góp được xử lý quá muộn.

segments.src: A short review in the next few weeks can help you avoid unpleasant surprises.
segments.tr: Một đánh giá ngắn trong vài tuần tới có thể giúp bạn tránh những bất ngờ khó chịu.

segments.src: When in doubt, check with your plan administrator or a tax professional, since limits and rules change from year to year.
segments.tr: Khi có thắc mắc, hãy hỏi quản trị viên kế hoạch hoặc chuyên gia thuế của bạn, vì các giới hạn và quy tắc thay đổi theo từng năm.

es.title: Úselo o piérdalo: los plazos financieros de fin de año que vale la pena revisar antes del 31 de diciembre

segments.src: With roughly two months left in 2026, now is a practical time to review a handful of money deadlines that fall on or near December 31.
segments.tr: Con aproximadamente dos meses restantes en 2026, ahora es un buen momento para revisar un puñado de plazos financieros que caen el 31 de diciembre o cerca de esa fecha.

segments.src: Some can cost you real money if missed, while others are optional but useful.
segments.tr: Algunos pueden costarle dinero real si se los pierde, mientras que otros son opcionales pero útiles.

segments.src: This guide covers which ones matter, who they apply to, and which are most often overlooked.
segments.tr: Esta guía cubre cuáles son importantes, a quiénes se aplican y cuáles se pasan por alto con mayor frecuencia.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax, legal or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Este artículo es información general, no asesoramiento fiscal, legal o financiero.

segments.src: Rules vary by plan and personal situation, so confirm details with your plan administrator, the IRS, or a qualified professional.*
segments.tr: Las reglas varían según el plan y la situación personal, así que confirme los detalles con el administrador de su plan, el IRS o un profesional calificado.*

segments.src: ## 1. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Check Your Plan's Rules
segments.tr: ## 1. Cuentas de gastos flexibles (FSA): revise las reglas de su plan

segments.src: A health care FSA lets you set aside pre-tax money for eligible medical expenses.
segments.tr: Una FSA de atención médica le permite reservar dinero antes de impuestos para gastos médicos elegibles.

segments.src: The classic drawback is the "use it or lose it" rule: money left unspent at the end of the plan year may be forfeited.
segments.tr: El inconveniente clásico es la regla de "úsalo o piérdelo": el dinero que no se gaste al final del año del plan puede perderse.

segments.src: Employers can soften that rule in one of two ways, but they are not required to offer either:
segments.tr: Los empleadores pueden suavizar esa regla de una de dos maneras, pero no están obligados a ofrecer ninguna de ellas:

segments.src: - **Carryover:** Some plans let you roll over a limited amount into the next year. The IRS adjusts the maximum carryover annually, so check the current figure with your plan.
segments.tr: - **Transferencia (Carryover):** Algunos planes le permiten transferir una cantidad limitada al año siguiente. El IRS ajusta el máximo de transferencia anualmente, así que verifique la cifra actual con su plan.

segments.src: - **Grace period:** Some plans give you extra time, up to two and a half months, to incur new expenses against last year's balance.
segments.tr: - **Período de gracia:** Algunos planes le dan tiempo adicional, hasta dos meses y medio, para incurrir en nuevos gastos contra el saldo del año pasado.

segments.src: A plan may offer one of these options, but not both.
segments.tr: Un plan puede ofrecer una de estas opciones, pero no ambas.

segments.src: Many employers offer neither.
segments.tr: Muchos empleadores no ofrecen ninguna.

segments.src: **What to do now:**
segments.tr: **Qué hacer ahora:**

segments.src: - Log in to your FSA portal and check your remaining balance and your plan's deadline.
segments.tr: - Inicie sesión en su portal de FSA y verifique su saldo restante y la fecha límite de su plan.

segments.src: - Find out whether your plan uses a carryover, a grace period, or nothing.
segments.tr: - Averigüe si su plan utiliza una transferencia, un período de gracia o nada.

segments.src: - Look at the claims run-out deadline. Even if you incur an expense on time, you usually must submit the claim by a set date.
segments.tr: - Observe la fecha límite de presentación de reclamos (run-out). Incluso si incurre en un gasto a tiempo, generalmente debe presentar el reclamo antes de una fecha determinada.

segments.src: - Spend wisely. Eligible items often include prescription copays, dental work, vision exams and glasses, and many over-the-counter products. Check your plan's eligibility list before buying.
segments.tr: - Gaste sabiamente. Los artículos elegibles a menudo incluyen copagos de recetas, trabajo dental, exámenes de la vista y anteojos, y muchos productos de venta libre. Verifique la lista de elegibilidad de su plan antes de comprar.

segments.src: Dependent care FSAs follow their own rules and often do not allow carryover, so check them separately.
segments.tr: Las FSA para el cuidado de dependientes siguen sus propias reglas y a menudo no permiten la transferencia, así que verifíquelas por separado.

segments.src: ## 2. Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
segments.tr: ## 2. Distribuciones mínimas requeridas (RMD)

segments.src: If you hold a traditional IRA or most employer retirement plans, the government eventually requires you to start withdrawing money.
segments.tr: Si tiene una cuenta IRA tradicional o la mayoría de los planes de jubilación del empleador, el gobierno eventualmente le exigirá que comience a retirar dinero.

segments.src: These withdrawals are called required minimum distributions.
segments.tr: Estos retiros se denominan distribuciones mínimas requeridas.

segments.src: Under current federal law, the starting age depends on your birth year.
segments.tr: Según la ley federal actual, la edad de inicio depende de su año de nacimiento.

segments.src: It is 73 for many people today and rises to 75 for those born in 1960 or later.
segments.tr: Es de 73 años para muchas personas hoy en día y aumenta a 75 para los nacidos en 1960 o después.

segments.src: Confirm your own age requirement with the IRS or a tax professional.
segments.tr: Confirme su propio requisito de edad con el IRS o un profesional de impuestos.

segments.src: Key points:
segments.tr: Puntos clave:

segments.src: - **The annual deadline is generally December 31.** Your first RMD is the exception: you may delay it until April 1 of the following year. Delaying means you take two distributions in one calendar year, which can push you into a higher tax bracket.
segments.tr: - **La fecha límite anual es generalmente el 31 de diciembre.** Su primera RMD es la excepción: puede retrasarla hasta el 1 de abril del año siguiente. Retrasarla significa que realiza dos distribuciones en un año calendario, lo que puede empujarlo a un tramo impositivo más alto.

segments.src: - **Missing an RMD carries a penalty.** The excise tax on a missed amount has been reduced in recent years, but it is still significant. The IRS may waive it if you show reasonable cause and correct the shortfall promptly.
segments.tr: - **No realizar una RMD conlleva una multa.** El impuesto especial sobre una cantidad no retirada se ha reducido en los últimos años, pero sigue siendo significativo. El IRS puede renunciar a ella si demuestra una causa razonable y corrige el déficit rápidamente.

segments.src: - **Calculations are done per account type.** Traditional IRAs can often be aggregated, so you may take the total from one account. Employer plans such as 401(k)s generally must be calculated and withdrawn separately.
segments.tr: - **Los cálculos se realizan por tipo de cuenta.** Las IRA tradicionales a menudo se pueden agregar, por lo que puede tomar el total de una cuenta. Los planes del empleador, como los 401(k), generalmente deben calcularse y retirarse por separado.

segments.src: - **Inherited accounts have their own rules.** Many beneficiaries must empty inherited retirement accounts within a set number of years, and some must also take annual distributions. This area is complicated and frequently misunderstood.
segments.tr: - **Las cuentas heredadas tienen sus propias reglas.** Muchos beneficiarios deben vaciar las cuentas de jubilación heredadas dentro de un número determinado de años, y algunos también deben realizar distribuciones anuales. Esta área es complicada y frecuentemente mal entendida.

segments.src: Roth IRAs do not require withdrawals during the original owner's lifetime.
segments.tr: Las Roth IRA no requieren retiros durante la vida del propietario original.

segments.src: **Commonly missed:** People who have several accounts, who recently changed custodians, or who inherited an account sometimes overlook one of them.
segments.tr: **Comúnmente omitido:** Las personas que tienen varias cuentas, que cambiaron recientemente de custodio o que heredaron una cuenta a veces pasan por alto una de ellas.

segments.src: Ask each custodian whether an RMD is due and what amount they calculated.
segments.tr: Pregunte a cada custodio si debe una RMD y qué cantidad calcularon.

segments.src: ## 3. Charitable Giving
segments.tr: ## 3. Donaciones caritativas

segments.src: Donations made by December 31 may count toward your 2026 tax year, but the benefit depends on whether you itemize deductions.
segments.tr: Las donaciones realizadas antes del 31 de diciembre pueden contar para su año fiscal 2026, pero el beneficio depende de si desglosa las deducciones.

segments.src: Points to consider:
segments.tr: Puntos a considerar:

segments.src: - **Itemizing vs. the standard deduction.** Most households take the standard deduction, which means a cash gift may not reduce taxes unless your total itemized deductions exceed it. Recent law changes have affected how charitable deductions work for different filers, so review the current rules for 2026.
segments.tr: - **Desglosar vs. deducción estándar.** La mayoría de los hogares toman la deducción estándar, lo que significa que una donación en efectivo puede no reducir los impuestos a menos que sus deducciones detalladas totales la excedan. Los cambios recientes en la ley han afectado cómo funcionan las deducciones caritativas para diferentes declarantes, así que revise las reglas actuales para 2026.
